	PROCEDURE actualizararticulosdescargar
		Local vGrabacion,mmpp,nCantADescargar,lPendiente,cRenglon, cId_sucursal
		local cId_sistema, cId_comproba, nNro_referencia
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		cId_sucursal = ""
		cId_sistema = ""
		cId_comproba = ""
		nNro_referencia = 0
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irPrimero()
		
		do while !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.esEoF()
			if cId_sucursal <> thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba") and;
			   cId_sistema <>  thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sistema")  and;
		   	   cId_comproba <> thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba") and;
		   	   nNro_referencia <> thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_referencia")
		
				cId_sucursal = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sucursal")
				cId_sistema  = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sistema")
				cId_comproba = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba")
				nNro_referencia = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_referencia")
				*** Martin
				thisform.oTblStk_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_sistema+cId_comproba+str(nNro_referencia,10), .F., "CLAVE")
				*** Martin
		
				lPendiente=.F.	
				
				Thisform.oTblStk_Detalle.FijarTag("CLAVE")
				
				Thisform.oTblStk_Detalle.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10), .F., "CLAVE")
				Do while !thisform.oTblStk_Detalle.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_Detalle.EsClaveIgual() and !lPendiente
				
					if thisForm.oTblStk_Detalle.leer("Cant_pendiente") <> 0
						lPendiente = .T.
					endIf
					
					thisform.oTblStk_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
				Enddo
		
				if !lPendiente
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fec_Modi"		 ,Date())
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cancelado_Desc",.t.)
					thisform.oTblStk_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				Endif	
				
				Thisform.oTblStk_Detalle.FijarTag("DESCARGA")		
			endIf
				thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irSiguiente()
		endDo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE comprobantedescargable
		lparameters cId_Comproba
		Local nRecnoAnterior,lEncontro
		
		
		lEncontro=.f.
		
		If Thisform.oTblDescarga.Localizar("Id_Com_Bas='"+ cId_Comproba +"' And Id_Sistema='S'") 
			lEncontro=.t.
		Endif
		
		Return lEncontro
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarajuste
		local vGrabacion, cId_deposito, cId_comprobaNuevo, nSigno, nNro_Referencia
		dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		cId_Deposito  = ""
		nNro_referencia = 0
		if !empty(thisForm.oTblParametros.leer("id_Comproba_ajuste_transferencia"))
		
			if thisForm.oTblStk_docu.buscar(thisForm.oTblParametros.leer("id_Comproba_ajuste_transferencia"))
				nSigno = iif(thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("suma"), 1, -1)
				cId_comprobaNuevo = thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("id_comproba")
			
				thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.revertir()
				thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irPrimero()	
				
				** Completo la lista auxiliar. ** 
				do while !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.EsEoF()
					
					if thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("descargado") and !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("Titulo")
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema" 	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sistema"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sucursal"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_referencia", thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_referencia"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_externo"	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_externo"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_deposito"	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_deposito"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cantidad"	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cantidad"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_pendiente", thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_pendiente"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_recibida" , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_recibida"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_articulo"	  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_articulo"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "detalle"		  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("detalle"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "renglon"		  , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("renglon"))
						thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
					endIf
					
					thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irSiguiente()
				endDo
				
				** Recorro la tabla auxiliar **
				thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.FijarTag("DEPOSITO")
				thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.irPrimero()
				
				do while !thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.esEoF()
				
					** Si la clave del comprobante es distinta, grabo una cabecera **
					if thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_Deposito") <> cId_Deposito 
						
						cId_deposito = thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_Deposito")
						nNro_referencia = thisForm.oTblStk_docu.incrementar("pro_referencia")			
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema"	 	 , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_sistema"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"	 	 , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_sucursal"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"	 	 , cId_comprobaNuevo)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_referencia"	 , nNro_referencia)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_deposito"	 	 , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_deposito"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "fecha"		 	 , date())
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_usuario"	 	 , oApp.usuario)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "maquina"		 	 , oApp.maquina)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "hora"		 	 , time())
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "fecha_clock"	 	 , date())
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "detalle"		 	 , "Movimiento automático: Ajuste de stock")
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "af_importacion"	 , thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("Af_importacion"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "produccion"	 	 , .F.)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_estadoComproba", "001")
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "suma"			 , thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("suma"))
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"cancelado_desc"	 ,thisForm.comprobanteDescargable(cId_comprobaNuevo))
						thisForm.oTblStk_cabecera.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)			
					endIf
								
					** Busco el artículo en Stk_detalle y le modifico la cantidad pendiente. **
					if thisForm.oTblStk_detalle.buscar(thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_sucursal") + thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_sistema")+;
						thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_comproba") + str(thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("nro_referencia"),10)+;
						thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_articulo") + thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("renglon"), .F., "DESCARGA")
							
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_pendiente", thisForm.oTblStk_detalle.leer("cant_pendiente")-thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("cant_recibida"))
						thisForm.oTblStk_detalle.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
					endIf		
		
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,cId_comprobaNuevo)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,oApp.CodSistema("Stock"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,nNro_referencia)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,oApp.CodSucursal())
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_articulo"		,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("id_articulo"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("detalle"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"			,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cant_Pendiente"	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Renglon"	    	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Renglon"))
					thisForm.oTblArticulos.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("id_articulo"), .F., "CLAVE")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Codigo_barras"	,thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Codigo_barras"))						
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"			,thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Costo"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_MonedaCosto"	,thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto"))
					thisform.oTblStk_DetalleAjuste.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
					
					** Modifico el stock en stk_stock **
					if !thisform.oTblStk_Stock.Buscar(oApp.CodSucursal()+thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_deposito"))
						=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Saldo"		,nSigno*thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
						=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
						=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_deposito"	,thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_deposito"))		
						=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"	,oApp.CodSucursal())							
						thisform.oTblStk_Stock.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
					Else	
						thisform.oTblStk_Stock.ActualizarSaldo ("saldo", nSigno*thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
					Endif
					
					** Agrego la descarga en Stk_descarga **
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"   , oApp.codSucursal())
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema"    , oApp.codSistema("STOCK"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"   , cId_comprobaNuevo)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_Referencia", nNro_referencia) 
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_cmp_cruce"  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_comproba"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_suc_cruce"  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_sucursal"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sis_cruce"  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_sistema"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_cruce"	  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("nro_referencia"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_articulo"   , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("id_articulo"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cantidad"	  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("cant_recibida"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "renglon"		  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.leer("renglon"))
					thisForm.oTblStk_descarga.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		
					thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.irSiguiente()
				endDo
				=fMensAceptar("Se ha realizado el ajuste correctamente.")
			else
				=fMensAceptar("El comprobante no existe.")	
			endIf
		else
			=fMensAceptar("Debe configurar el comprobante que utilizará para realizar la salida.")
		endIf
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabartransferencia
		local vGrabacion, cId_deposito, cId_comprobaNuevo, nSigno, nNro_Referencia, nPro_referencia
		dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		cId_deposito = ""
		cId_comproba = thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbComprobantesStock1.value
		thisForm.oTblStk_docu.buscar(cId_comproba, .F., "CLAVE")
		nSigno = iif(thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("suma"), 1, -1)
		
		thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.revertir()
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irPrimero()	
		
		** Completo la lista auxiliar. ** 
		do while !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.EsEoF()
			
			if thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("descargado") and !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("Titulo")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema" 	  		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sistema"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"	  		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sucursal"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"	  		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_referencia"		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_referencia"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_externo"	  		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_externo"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_deposito"	  		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_deposito"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_depositoTransfiere", thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_depositoTransferencia"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_depositoReceptor"	 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_depositoDesc"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cantidad"	 		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cantidad"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_pendiente"		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_pendiente"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_recibida"		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_recibida"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_articulo"	 		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_articulo"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "detalle"				 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("detalle"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "renglon"		 		 , thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("renglon"))
				thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
			endIf
			
			thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irSiguiente()
		endDo
		
		** Recorro la tabla auxiliar **
		thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.FijarTag("DEPOSITO")
		thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.irPrimero()
		
		do while !thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.esEoF()
		
			** Si la clave del comprobante es distinta, grabo una cabecera **
			if thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_Deposito") <> cId_Deposito 
				
				cId_deposito = thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_Deposito")
				nNro_referencia = thisForm.oTblStk_docu.incrementar("pro_referencia")
				nPro_referencia = thisForm.oTblStk_docu.incrementar("pro_referencia")		
				
				** Grabo la entrada. **	
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema"	 	 , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_sistema"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"	 	 , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_sucursal"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"	 	 , cId_comproba)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_referencia"	 , nNro_referencia)
				&& MATIAS L. 22/10/2018
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_Externo"		 ,"00000-"+padl(nNro_referencia,8,'0'))
		*!*			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_Externo"		 ,"0000-"+padl(nNro_referencia,8,'0'))
				&& MATIAS L. 22/10/2018
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_deposito"	 	 , thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbDepositos1.value)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "fecha"		 	 , date())
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_usuario"	 	 , oApp.usuario)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "maquina"		 	 , oApp.maquina)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "hora"		 	 , time())
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "fecha_clock"	 	 , date())
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "detalle"		 	 , "Movimiento automático: Transferencia de Stock.")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "af_importacion"	 , thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("Af_importacion"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "produccion"	 	 , .F.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_estadoComproba", "001")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "suma"			 , thisForm.oTblStk_docu.leer("suma"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cancelado_desc"	 , !thisForm.comprobanteDescargable(cId_comproba))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "transferencia"	 , .T.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_Transferencia", nPro_referencia)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_depositoTransferencia", thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_deposito"))
				thisForm.oTblStk_cabecera.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .F.)	
				
				** Grabo la salida. **
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"			,nPro_referencia)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Suma"						,!thisform.oTblStk_Docu.Leer("Suma"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Deposito"				,thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_deposito"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Transferencia"    		,.T.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Transferencia"		,nNro_referencia)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_DepositoTransferencia" ,thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbDepositos1.value)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"cancelado_desc"			,thisForm.comprobanteDescargable(thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbComprobantesStock1.value))
				thisform.oTblStk_Cabecera.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.T.)		
			endIf
			
			** Busco el artículo en Stk_detalle y le modifico la cantidad pendiente. **
			if thisForm.oTblStk_detalle.buscar(thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_sucursal") + thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_sistema")+;
				thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_comproba") + str(thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("nro_referencia"),10)+;
				thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_articulo") + thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("renglon"), .F., "DESCARGA")
				
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_pendiente", thisForm.oTblStk_detalle.leer("cant_pendiente")-thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("cant_recibida"))
				thisForm.oTblStk_detalle.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
			endIf		
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,cId_comproba)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,oApp.CodSistema("Stock"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,nNro_referencia)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,oApp.CodSucursal())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_articulo"		,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("id_articulo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("detalle"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"			,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cant_Pendiente"	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Renglon"	    	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Renglon"))
			thisForm.oTblArticulos.buscar(thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("id_articulo"), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Codigo_barras"	,thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Codigo_barras"))						
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"			,thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Costo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_MonedaCosto"	,thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto"))
			thisform.oTblStk_DetalleAjuste.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.F.)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,nPro_referencia)
			thisform.oTblStk_DetalleAjuste.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.T.)
			
			** Modifico el stock en stk_stock **
			** Sumo en el depósito que recibe. **
			if !thisform.oTblStk_Stock.Buscar(oApp.CodSucursal()+thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbDepositos1.value)
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Saldo"		,nSigno*thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_deposito"	,thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbDepositos1.value)		
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"	,oApp.CodSucursal())							
				thisform.oTblStk_Stock.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			Else	
				thisform.oTblStk_Stock.ActualizarSaldo ("saldo", nSigno*thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
			Endif
			
			** Resto en el depósito virtual. **
			if !thisform.oTblStk_Stock.Buscar(oApp.CodSucursal()+thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Id_Articulo")+thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_deposito"))
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Saldo"		,-nSigno*thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"	,thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_deposito"	,thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_deposito"))		
				=fgrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"	,oApp.CodSucursal())							
				thisform.oTblStk_Stock.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			Else	
				thisform.oTblStk_Stock.ActualizarSaldo ("saldo", -nSigno*thisform.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.Leer("Cant_recibida"))
			Endif
			
			** Agrego la descarga en Stk_descarga **
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sucursal"   , oApp.codSucursal())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sistema"    , oApp.codSistema("STOCK"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_comproba"   , cId_comproba)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_Referencia", nNro_referencia) 
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_cmp_cruce"  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_comproba"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_suc_cruce"  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_sucursal"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_sis_cruce"  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_sistema"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "nro_cruce"	  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("nro_referencia"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "id_articulo"   , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("id_articulo"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cantidad"	  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("cant_recibida"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "renglon"		  , thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.leer("renglon"))
			thisForm.oTblStk_descarga.agregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		
			thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.irSiguiente()
		endDo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE inicializarcontroles
		local cListaDeptosDesde, cListaDeptosDesde2, cComprobantes
		
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
		ThisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_grid1.Column6.ReadOnly=.f.
		ThisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_grid1.Column6.DynamicCurrentControl="iif(Thisform.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.Leer('Titulo'),'oCmdTotal','Tg_checkbox1')"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
		
		thisForm.nCantidad_anterior = 0
		
		If !oApp.perfilAdministrador()
		
			if thisForm.oTblDepositos_usuarios.buscar(oApp.codUsuario()+"S", .F., "DEPDESDE")
				cListaDeptosDesde="InList(id_deposito"
		
				do while !thisForm.oTblDepositos_usuarios.esEoF()and thisForm.oTblDepositos_usuarios.esClaveIgual()
					cListaDeptosDesde = cListaDeptosDesde+ ",'" + thisform.oTblDepositos_usuarios.Leer("id_depositoTransfiere") + "'"
					thisForm.oTblDepositos_usuarios.irSiguiente()
				endDo	
		
				cListaDeptosDesde=cListaDeptosDesde+ ")"
				ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_cmbdepositos1.filtrar(cListaDeptosDesde)
				ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbDepositos1.filtrar(cListaDeptosDesde)
			else 
				ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_cmbdepositos1.filtrar(".F.")
				ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbdepositos1.filtrar(".F.")		
			endIf
			
		else
			ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_cmbDepositos1.irPrimero()
		endIf
		ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_cmbdepositos2.setearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_cmbdepositos2.setearDefault("TD")
			
		ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbdepositos1.setearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_cmbdepositos1.setearDefault("TD")
		
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_cmbComprobantesStock1.filtrar("transferencia_entre_sucursales and !confeccion and oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',id_Comproba,'A',oApp.CodSistema('Stock'))")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		doDefault()
		
		thisForm.addObject("oTblParametros"						  , "tg_Tabla" , "parametros")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblStk_descarga"					  , "tg_tabla" , "stk_descarga")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblArticulos"						  , "tg_tabla" , "articulos"				 , "CLAVE") 
		thisForm.addObject("oTblUsuarios"					      , "tg_tabla" , "usuarios"					 , "CLAVE")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblStk_cabecera"					  , "tg_tabla" , "stk_cabecera"				 , "CLAVE")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblStk_stock"						  , "tg_tabla" , "stk_stock"				 , "CLAVE")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblStk_docu"						  , "tg_tabla" , "stk_docu"   				 , "CLAVE")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblDescarga"						  , "tg_tabla" , "descarga"   				 , "CLAVE")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblStk_detalle"					  , "tg_tabla" , "stk_detalle"				 , "DESCARGA") 
		thisForm.addObject("oTblStk_detalleAjuste"				  , "tg_tabla" , "stk_detalle"				 , "DESCARGA") 
		thisForm.addObject("oTblDepositos_usuarios" 			  , "tg_tabla" , "depositos_usuarios"		 , "DEPDESDE")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste" , "tg_tabla" , "Aux_transferenciasInternas", "DEPOSITO")
		thisForm.addObject("oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba", "tg_tabla" , "Aux_transferenciasInternas", "DEPOSITO")
		
		thisForm.addObject("oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios"   , "tg_ViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios")
		thisForm.addObject("oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion", "tg_viewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion")
		
		thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAjuste.setearProp("BOT")
		thisForm.oTblAux_transferenciasInternasAprueba.setearProp("BOT")
		
		thisForm.inicializarControles()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		local nColumnas, cPictureCantidad
		
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias
		
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column1.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".id_articulo"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column2.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".detalle"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column3.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".cantidad"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column4.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".cant_pendiente"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column5.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".cant_recibida"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column6.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".descargado"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column7.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".id_comproba"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column8.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".nro_referencia"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column9.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.alias+".nro_externo"
		
		thisForm.oTblStk_docu.buscar(thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbcomprobantesStock1.value, .F., "CLAVE")
		cPictureCantidad=Replicate("9",thisform.oTblStk_Docu.Leer("Enteros_Cantidad"))+"."+Replicate("9",thisform.oTblstk_docu.Leer("Decimales_Cantidad"))
		
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column3.inputMask = cPictureCantidad
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column4.inputMask = cPictureCantidad
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column5.inputMask = cPictureCantidad
		
		For nColumnas = 1 To Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.ColumnCount
			Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.Columns(nColumnas).DynamicBackColor = "iif (thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer('titulo'),rgb(130,179,179), rgb(255,255,255))"
			
			If nColumnas <> 2
				Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page1.Tg_Grid1.Columns(nColumnas).DynamicForeColor = "iif (thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer('titulo'),rgb(130,179,179), rgb(0,0,0))"
			Endif
		EndFor
		
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irPrimero()
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrillaenvios
		local nColumnas
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.recordSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias
		
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column1.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".id_sistema"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column2.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".id_sucursal"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column3.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".id_comproba"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column4.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".nro_referencia"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column5.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".nro_externo"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column6.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".fecha"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column7.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".nombreDepositoEnvia"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column8.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".nombreDepositoRecibe"
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.column9.controlSource = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.alias+".nombreComproba"
		
		
		For nColumnas = 1 To Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page2.Tg_Grid1.ColumnCount
			Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page2.Tg_Grid1.Columns(nColumnas).DynamicBackColor = "iif (thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.leer('cancelado_desc'),rgb(189,236,182), rgb(255,255,255))"
		endFor
		
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.irPrimero()
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.refresh()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarvistaenvios
		thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasEnvios.refrescar(thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_cmbdepositos1.value, thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.tg_optionGroup1.value)
		thisForm.refrescarGrillaEnvios()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE traervista
		Dimension vTipoComprobantesBase[1]
		vTipoComprobantesBase[1] = Space(3)
		
		Dimension vComprobantes[1]
		vComprobantes[1] = Space(3)
		
		Thisform.oTblDescarga.Buscar("S"+Thisform.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_cmbcomprobantesstock1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		
		Do While !Thisform.oTblDescarga.EsEof() And ;
			Thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Comproba")= Thisform.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_cmbcomprobantesstock1.Value And ;
			Thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Sistema") = "S"		
			
			If Not Empty(vTipoComprobantesBase[Alen(vTipoComprobantesBase)])
				Dimension vTipoComprobantesBase[Alen(vTipoComprobantesBase) + 1 ]	   
			Endif   
			
			vTipoComprobantesBase[Alen(vTipoComprobantesBase)]=Thisform.oTblDescarga.Leer("Id_Com_Bas")
		
			Thisform.oTblDescarga.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo	
		
		=aCopy(vTipoComprobantesBase,vComprobantes)
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.refrescar(Thisform.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_cmbdepositos1.value, @vComprobantes, Thisform.tg_pageFrame1.page1.Tg_cmbdepositos2.value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validargrabacion
		local lContinua, lPodergrabar
		
		lContinua = .T.
		lPodergrabar = .F.
		
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irPrimero()
		do while !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.esEoF()
		
			if thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_recibida") > 0
				lPodergrabar = .T.		
			endIf	
		
			if thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_recibida") < 0
				lContinua = .F.		
			endIf
		
			thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.irSiguiente()
		endDo
		
		Do Case
			Case !lContinua 
				=fMensAceptar("Asegurese que las cantidades recibidas sean mayores o iguales a 0.")
		
			Case !lPodergrabar
				=fMensAceptar("Asegurese de marcar algo para descargar.")
		
		EndCase
		
		return lContinua And lPodergrabar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.tg_btnAprobar.Click
		local cRespuesta 
		cRespuesta = ""
		
		if thisForm.validarGrabacion()
			cRespuesta = fMensPregunto("¿Confirma las transferencias?","S")
			if cRespuesta = "S"
				thisForm.grabarTransferencia()
				thisForm.actualizarArticulosDescargar()
				thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
				thisForm.traerVista()
				=fMensAceptar("La transferencia se grabó exitosamente.")
				thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
			endIf
		endIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		if !empty(thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbDepositos1.value) and !empty(thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_cmbcomprobantesStock1.value)
			thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
			thisForm.traerVista()
			thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
		else
			=fMensAceptar("Asegurese de elegir un depósito y un comprobante.")
		endIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		local cRespuesta 
		cRespuesta = ""
		
		if thisForm.validarGrabacion()
			cRespuesta = fMensPregunto("¿Confirma la realización del ajuste?","S")
			if cRespuesta = "S"
				thisForm.grabarAjuste()
				thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.recordSource = ""
				thisForm.traerVista()
				thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
			endIf
		endIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.InteractiveChange
		if thisForm.nCantidad_anterior <> this.value
			if thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer('titulo')
				if this.value <> 0
					this.value = 0
				endIf		
			else
				if this.value <> 0
					ThisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column6.tg_checkbox1.value = .T.
				else
					ThisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page1.tg_grid1.column6.tg_checkbox1.value = .F.
				endIf
				thisForm.nCantidad_anterior = this.value
			endIf
		endIf
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		local lValida, vGrabacion
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		lValida = .F.
		
		
		If Thisform.oTblStk_docu.leer("Validar_descarga")
			If thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_recibida") > thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_pendiente")
				=fMensAceptar("La cantidad recibida no puede ser mayor a la cantidad pendiente.")	
		
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "descargado", .F.)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_recibida", 0) 
				thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)		
			endIf
		Endif
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_grid1.Column6.oCmdTotal.Click
		local nNro_referencia, cId_comproba, cId_sistema, cId_sucursal, vDatos, lDescarga, lVez
		dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		nNro_referencia = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_referencia")
		cId_comproba = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba")
		cId_sistema  = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sistema")
		cId_sucursal = thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sucursal")
		lVez = .T.
		
		Do while !thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.esEoF();
			and thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("nro_referencia") = nNro_referencia;
			and thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_comproba") = cId_comproba;
			and thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sistema") = cId_sistema;
			and thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("id_sucursal") = cId_sucursal
			
			
			If Not thisform.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.Leer("Titulo")
				If lVez
					lDescarga = !thisform.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.Leer("descargado")
					lVez=.f.
				Endif
			
				If lDescarga			
					if lDescarga
						=fGrabar(@vDatos,"cant_recibida", thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_pendiente"))
					Else
						=fGrabar(@vDatos,"cant_recibida",	0)
					Endif
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"cant_recibida",0 )
				Endif
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"descargado", lDescarga )
				thisform.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			Endif
			
			
			thisform.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page1.Tg_grid1.Column6.Tg_checkbox1.InteractiveChange
		local nNro_referencia, cId_comproba, cId_sistema, cId_sucursal, vGrabacion, lEstado
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nNro_referencia = 0
		cId_comproba = ""
		cId_sistema = ""
		cId_sucursal = ""
		
		lEstado = this.value
		if !lEstado
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "descargado", .F.)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_recibida", 0)
		else
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "descargado", .T.)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "cant_recibida", thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.leer("cant_pendiente"))
		endIf
		thisForm.oViewTransferenciasInternasRecepcion.modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_pageframe1.Page2.Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		
		If Empty(thisForm.tg_pageFrame1.page2.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe seleccionar el depósito a consultar!!")
		Else
			thisForm.refrescarVistaEnvios()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarlistadeprecios
		local mmpp, cId_Lista
		mmpp= 1
		
		thisform.ovnt_Docu.IrPrimero
		
		Do while !thisform.oVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		   If !Empty(thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Lista")) And AScan(ThisForm.vListaPrecios,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Lista"))!=0
			  
			  cId_Lista= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Lista")
			  thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(cId_Lista)
		
			  ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,1] =thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Nombre")
		      ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2] =cId_Lista
		      mmpp= mmpp+ 1
		      Dimension ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2]
		   Endif
		   thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		If Type("ThisForm.vListaPrecios[1,2]")= "L"
		   thisform.oListaPrecios.IrPrimero
		
		   Do while !thisform.oListaPrecios.EsEof()
			  ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,1] =thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Nombre")
		      ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2] =thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Lista")
		      mmpp= mmpp+ 1
		      Dimension ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2]
		
		      thisform.oListaPrecios.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		Endif
		
		Dimension ThisForm.vListaPrecios[alen(ThisForm.vListaPrecios,1)-1,2]
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.RowSourceType = 5  
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.RowSource = 'thisform.vListaPrecios' 
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.Value= thisform.vListaPrecios[1,1]
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardardistribucion
		*** Martin
		
		local mmpp,vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If Type("ThisForm.Tg_combobox1.Value")=T_CHARACTER
				thisform.oTblArch_sel.Buscar("ARTICULOS")
				Do While thisform.oTblArch_sel.EsClaveIgual()
					If Alltrim(thisform.oTblArch_sel.Leer("Tit_Ind"))=Alltrim(ThisForm.Tg_combobox1.Value)
						vGrabacion[1,1]="Defecto"
						vGrabacion[1,2]=.t.
					Else
						vGrabacion[1,1]="Defecto"
						vGrabacion[1,2]=.f.
					Endif					
					thisform.oTblArch_sel.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
					
					thisform.oTblArch_sel.IrSiguiente()
				enddo
		Endif
		
		*** Martin
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewPreciosdeArticulos","Tg_ViewPreciosdeArticulos")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCondiciones","Tg_Tabla","Condiciones","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oListaPrecios","tg_tabla","ListaPrecios","clave")
		*** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArch_Sel","Tg_Tabla","Arch_Sel","Archivo")
		*** Martin
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos","Tg_FiltrosPanelArticulos")				
		
		thisform.AliasArchivo= thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.AliasArchivo
		Thisform.Orden= "Clave"
		thisform.Vista= .f.
		thisform.TipoConsulta= 3  
		*** tipoConsulta = 0  Refrescar Consulta
		*** tipoConsulta = 1  Calcular Solamente el Porcentaje de Recargo
		*** tipoConsulta = 2  Fija el Tag de la Vista
		*** tipoConsulta = 3  Consulta por Primera vez
		
		*** Martin
		Thisform.vOrden[1,1]= "Id de Artículo "+space(50)
		Thisform.vOrden[1,2]= "Clave"
		Thisform.vOrden[2,1]= "Nombre"
		Thisform.vOrden[2,2]= "Nombre"+space(50)
		*** Martin
		
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.RowSourceType = 5  
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.RowSource = 'thisform.vOrden' 
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.Style= 2
		
		*** Martin
		Thisform.PonerBusquedaDefecto()
		
		If Empty(Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value)
			Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value= Thisform.vOrden[1,1]
		Endif
		*** Martin
			
		** Lucas 06/04/2009
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.OldId_Marca    		= thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value
		** Lucas 06/04/2009
			
		thisform.recno=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.recno()
		
		thisform.CargarListadePrecios()
		
		thisform.vCampos[1,1]= "Id_Articulo"
		thisform.vCampos[2,1]= "Nombre"
		thisform.vCampos[3,1]= "Precio"
		
		with thisform.tg_grid1
		     .setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(thisform.recno=recno('"+thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+"'),rgb(0,0,160),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
		     .setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(thisform.recno=recno('"+thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+"'),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
					
		    .refresh
		endwith
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
		thisform.Tg_textBox1.SeleccionarTexto
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpanelcontrolarticulos
		local dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp, cDeposito, mmpp, nCant
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		Local vDepositosSel, vCmp_DocuAux, vVnt_DocuAux
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		
		Dimension vDepositosSel[1,2]
		
		dFechaMaximaCmp= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.MostrarFecPenCmp()
		dFechaMaximaVta= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.MostrarFecPendVta() 
		cDeposito= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.MostrarDepositos()
		
		if cDeposito = "TD"
		   vDepositosSel[1,1]= 2
		else
		   vDepositosSel[1,1]= 1
		   vDepositosSel[1,2]= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_CmbDepositos1.value
		endif   
		
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		Dimension vCmp_DocuAux[Alen(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,1),2]
		Dimension vVnt_DocuAux[Alen(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,1),2]
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		
		=aCopy(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vCmp_DocuAux )
		=aCopy(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vVnt_DocuAux )
		
		mmpp=  1
		nCant= 1
		Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		
		For mmpp= 1 to Alen(vCmp_DocuAux,1)
		    if vCmp_DocuAux[mmpp,2]
		       vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]= vCmp_DocuAux[mmpp,1]
		       nCant= nCant+1
		       Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		    endif   
		EndFor	
		
		if Alen(vCmp_DocuAux,1) = (nCant -1) .or. nCant= 1
		   vCmp_DocuSel[1,1]= 3
		else
		   vCmp_DocuSel[1,1]= 1   
		endif 
		
		if nCant <> 1
		   Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[alen(vCmp_DocuSel,1)-1,2]
		endif   
		
		mmpp=  1
		nCant= 1
		Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		
		For mmpp= 1 to Alen(vVnt_DocuAux,1)
		    if vVnt_DocuAux[mmpp,2]
		       vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]= vVnt_DocuAux[mmpp,1]
		       nCant= nCant+1
		       Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		    endif   
		EndFor	
		
		if Alen(vVnt_DocuAux,1)= (nCant -1) .or. nCant= 1
		   vVnt_DocuSel[1,1]= 3
		else
		   vVnt_DocuSel[1,1]= 1   
		endif 
		
		if nCant <> 1
		   Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[alen(vVnt_DocuSel,1)-1,2]
		endif   
		
		If Type("thisform.oFormPanelCtlArticulos") <> "O"

		else
			thisform.oFormPanelCtlArticulos.CalcularStockGral( thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo"),@vVnt_DocuSel,@vCmp_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp,@vVnt_DocuAux,@vCmp_DocuAux )

	PROCEDURE ponerbusquedadefecto
		thisform.oTblArch_sel.Buscar("ARTICULOS")
		
		
		Do While thisform.oTblArch_sel.EsClaveIgual()
			If Thisform.oTblArch_Sel.Leer("Defecto") And ; 
				(Upper(Thisform.oTblArch_Sel.Leer("Campo")) ="ID_ARTICULO" Or ;
				Upper(Thisform.oTblArch_Sel.Leer("Campo")) ="NOMBRE")
				
				Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value= Alltrim(thisform.oTblArch_sel.Leer("Tit_Ind"))
				If Alltrim(Upper(Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value))="NOMBRE"
					Thisform.Orden= "Nombre"
				ELSE
					Thisform.Orden= "Clave"
				Endif
		
			Endif	
						
			thisform.oTblArch_sel.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.InteractiveChange
		local oArch
		
		
		** Matias L. 11/05/2020
		LOCAL cStringBuscar , cClave
		cStringBuscar  = .T.
		IF !EMPTY(this.value)
			IF ALLTRIM(UPPER(thisform.Orden)) = "CLAVE"
				cClave = "ID_ARTICULO"
			ELSE 
				cClave = ALLTRIM(UPPER(thisform.Orden))
			endif
			cStringBuscar = "like('*" + UPPER(ALLTRIM(this.value)) + "*'," + UPPER(cClave) +")"
		ENDIF
		
		
		thisForm.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Desfiltrar()
		
		thisForm.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Filtrar(cStringBuscar)
		
		thisForm.tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		
		*!*	If Type("this.Value")= "C"
		*!*		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Buscar(alltrim(this.value),.t.,thisform.Orden)
		*!*	Else
		*!*		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Buscar(this.value,.t.,thisform.Orden)
		*!*	Endif	
		
		*!*	if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
		*!*		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrUltimo
		*!*	endif
		*!*	if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsBof()
		*!*		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrPrimero
		*!*	endif
		** Matias L. 11/05/2020
		thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
		
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		if .f. && lo hace muy lento por ahora
		if nkeycode=5.or.nkeycode=24.or.nkeycode=3.or.nkeycode=18
			do case 
				case nkeycode=5
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Esbof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrAnterior
					 	if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Esbof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrPrimero
					 	endif	
					 	thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					endif 	
			
				case nkeycode=24	
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrSiguiente
						if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrUltimo
						endif	
			
			 			thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					
					endif	
				case nkeycode=18
				
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Esbof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Saltar(-12)
						if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsBof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrPrimero
						endif	
			
			 			thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					
					endif	
					
				case nkeycode=3	
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Saltar(12)
						if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrUltimo
						endif	
			
			 			thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					
					endif	
			endcase
			mdato=thisform.Aliasarchivo+"."+thisform.vcampos[thisform.tg_combobox1.listindex,1]
			
			this.value=&mDato
		endif	
		endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.Valid
		local mlastkey,mretorna
		
		mlastkey=lastkey()
		mretorna=.t.
		if mlastkey=5.or.mlastkey=24.or. mlastkey=18.or.mlastkey=3
			mretorna=.f.
		endif
		if !mretorna
			keyboard chr(6)
		endif
		return mretorna	
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarlistadeprecios
		local mmpp, cId_Lista
		mmpp= 1
		
		thisform.ovnt_Docu.IrPrimero
		
		Do while !thisform.oVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		   If !Empty(thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Lista")) And AScan(ThisForm.vListaPrecios,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Lista"))!=0
			  
			  cId_Lista= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Lista")
			  thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(cId_Lista)
		
			  ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,1] =thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Nombre")
		      ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2] =cId_Lista
		      mmpp= mmpp+ 1
		      Dimension ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2]
		   Endif
		   thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		If Type("ThisForm.vListaPrecios[1,2]")= "L"
		   thisform.oListaPrecios.IrPrimero
		
		   Do while !thisform.oListaPrecios.EsEof()
			  ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,1] =thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Nombre")
		      ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2] =thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Lista")
		      mmpp= mmpp+ 1
		      Dimension ThisForm.vListaPrecios[mmpp,2]
		
		      thisform.oListaPrecios.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		Endif
		
		Dimension ThisForm.vListaPrecios[alen(ThisForm.vListaPrecios,1)-1,2]
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.RowSourceType = 5  
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.RowSource = 'thisform.vListaPrecios' 
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.Value= thisform.vListaPrecios[1,1]
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE guardardistribucion
		*** Martin
		
		local mmpp,vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If Type("ThisForm.Tg_combobox1.Value")=T_CHARACTER
				thisform.oTblArch_sel.Buscar("ARTICULOS")
				Do While thisform.oTblArch_sel.EsClaveIgual()
					If Alltrim(thisform.oTblArch_sel.Leer("Tit_Ind"))=Alltrim(ThisForm.Tg_combobox1.Value)
						vGrabacion[1,1]="Defecto"
						vGrabacion[1,2]=.t.
					Else
						vGrabacion[1,1]="Defecto"
						vGrabacion[1,2]=.f.
					Endif					
					thisform.oTblArch_sel.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
					
					thisform.oTblArch_sel.IrSiguiente()
				enddo
		Endif
		
		*** Martin
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewPreciosdeArticulos","Tg_ViewPreciosdeArticulos")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCondiciones","Tg_Tabla","Condiciones","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oListaPrecios","tg_tabla","ListaPrecios","clave")
		*** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArch_Sel","Tg_Tabla","Arch_Sel","Archivo")
		*** Martin
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos","Tg_FiltrosPanelArticulos")				
		
		thisform.AliasArchivo= thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.AliasArchivo
		Thisform.Orden= "Clave"
		thisform.Vista= .f.
		thisform.TipoConsulta= 3  
		*** tipoConsulta = 0  Refrescar Consulta
		*** tipoConsulta = 1  Calcular Solamente el Porcentaje de Recargo
		*** tipoConsulta = 2  Fija el Tag de la Vista
		*** tipoConsulta = 3  Consulta por Primera vez
		
		*** Martin
		Thisform.vOrden[1,1]= "Id de Artículo "+space(50)
		Thisform.vOrden[1,2]= "Clave"
		Thisform.vOrden[2,1]= "Nombre"
		Thisform.vOrden[2,2]= "Nombre"+space(50)
		*** Martin
		
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.RowSourceType = 5  
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.RowSource = 'thisform.vOrden' 
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.Style= 2
		
		*** Martin
		Thisform.PonerBusquedaDefecto()
		
		If Empty(Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value)
			Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value= Thisform.vOrden[1,1]
		Endif
		*** Martin
			
		** Lucas 06/04/2009
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.OldId_Marca    		= thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value
		** Lucas 06/04/2009
			
		thisform.recno=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.recno()
		
		thisform.CargarListadePrecios()
		
		thisform.vCampos[1,1]= "Id_Articulo"
		thisform.vCampos[2,1]= "Nombre"
		thisform.vCampos[3,1]= "Precio"
		
		with thisform.tg_grid1
		     .setall("dynamicbackcolor","iif(thisform.recno=recno('"+thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+"'),rgb(0,0,160),rgb(255,255,255))","column")
		     .setall("dynamicforecolor","iif(thisform.recno=recno('"+thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+"'),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))","column")
					
		    .refresh
		endwith
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
		thisform.Tg_textBox1.SeleccionarTexto
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpanelcontrolarticulos
		local dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp, cDeposito, mmpp, nCant
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		Local vDepositosSel, vCmp_DocuAux, vVnt_DocuAux
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		
		Dimension vDepositosSel[1,2]
		
		dFechaMaximaCmp= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.MostrarFecPenCmp()
		dFechaMaximaVta= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.MostrarFecPendVta() 
		cDeposito= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.MostrarDepositos()
		
		if cDeposito = "TD"
		   vDepositosSel[1,1]= 2
		else
		   vDepositosSel[1,1]= 1
		   vDepositosSel[1,2]= thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_CmbDepositos1.value
		endif   
		
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		Dimension vCmp_DocuAux[Alen(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,1),2]
		Dimension vVnt_DocuAux[Alen(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,1),2]
		** LUCHO M. 30/06/2010
		
		=aCopy(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vCmp_DocuAux )
		=aCopy(thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vVnt_DocuAux )
		
		mmpp=  1
		nCant= 1
		Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		
		For mmpp= 1 to Alen(vCmp_DocuAux,1)
		    if vCmp_DocuAux[mmpp,2]
		       vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]= vCmp_DocuAux[mmpp,1]
		       nCant= nCant+1
		       Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		    endif   
		EndFor	
		
		if Alen(vCmp_DocuAux,1) = (nCant -1) .or. nCant= 1
		   vCmp_DocuSel[1,1]= 3
		else
		   vCmp_DocuSel[1,1]= 1   
		endif 
		
		if nCant <> 1
		   Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[alen(vCmp_DocuSel,1)-1,2]
		endif   
		
		mmpp=  1
		nCant= 1
		Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		
		For mmpp= 1 to Alen(vVnt_DocuAux,1)
		    if vVnt_DocuAux[mmpp,2]
		       vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]= vVnt_DocuAux[mmpp,1]
		       nCant= nCant+1
		       Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		    endif   
		EndFor	
		
		if Alen(vVnt_DocuAux,1)= (nCant -1) .or. nCant= 1
		   vVnt_DocuSel[1,1]= 3
		else
		   vVnt_DocuSel[1,1]= 1   
		endif 
		
		if nCant <> 1
		   Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[alen(vVnt_DocuSel,1)-1,2]
		endif   
		
		If Type("thisform.oFormPanelCtlArticulos") <> "O"			 
			thisform.oFormPanelCtlArticulos= CreateObject("Tg_PaneldeControlArticulos", thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo"),@vVnt_DocuSel,@vCmp_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp,@vVnt_DocuAux,@vCmp_DocuAux )				
		else
			thisform.oFormPanelCtlArticulos.CalcularStockGral( thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo"),@vVnt_DocuSel,@vCmp_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp,@vVnt_DocuAux,@vCmp_DocuAux )			
		Endif	
		
		Thisform.oFormPanelCtlArticulos.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponerbusquedadefecto
		thisform.oTblArch_sel.Buscar("ARTICULOS")
		
		
		Do While thisform.oTblArch_sel.EsClaveIgual()
			If Thisform.oTblArch_Sel.Leer("Defecto") And ; 
				(Upper(Thisform.oTblArch_Sel.Leer("Campo")) ="ID_ARTICULO" Or ;
				Upper(Thisform.oTblArch_Sel.Leer("Campo")) ="NOMBRE")
				
				Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value= Alltrim(thisform.oTblArch_sel.Leer("Tit_Ind"))
				If Alltrim(Upper(Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.value))="NOMBRE"
					Thisform.Orden= "Nombre"
				Else
					Thisform.Orden= "Clave"
				Endif
		
			Endif	
						
			thisform.oTblArch_sel.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Lista,nPorc_Recargo, cOrden, nTipoConsulta, cId_Marca
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Refrescar(cId_Lista,nPorc_Recargo, cOrden, nTipoConsulta , cId_Marca)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".Precio"
		**** Martin
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".Disponible"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".uni_medida"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".coef_uni_med2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".uni_medida2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".Ubicacion"
		*** Martin
		** Lucas
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Alias+".NombreMarca"
		** Lucas
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcondiciones1.InteractiveChange
		local cMensaje
		Thisform.Recargo= 0
		thisform.TipoConsulta= iif(thisform.TipoConsulta= 3,0,1)
		 
		Thisform.oTblCondiciones.Buscar(This.value,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.Recargo= thisform.oTblCondiciones.Leer("Porc_Recargo")
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(thisform.vListaPrecios(thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.ListIndex,2), Thisform.Recargo, Thisform.Orden,thisform.TipoConsulta ,thisform.OldId_Marca)
		
		*** Martin
		If Alltrim(Upper(Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.Value)) = "NOMBRE"
			thisform.Tg_Textbox1.value= thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_Textbox1.value= thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		Endif
		*** Martin
		
		Thisform.Tg_Textbox1.enabled= .t.
		Thisform.Tg_Combobox1.enabled= .t.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbListadePrecios.InteractiveChange
		thisform.TipoConsulta= 0
		
		if !empty(Thisform.Tg_CmbCondiciones1.value)
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta(thisform.vListaPrecios(this.ListIndex,2), Thisform.Recargo, Thisform.Orden , thisform.TipoConsulta , thisform.OldId_Marca)
		   thisform.Tg_Textbox1.value= thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		else
		   cMensaje= "Debe Seleccionar la Condicion de Pago!"
		   =fMensAceptar(cMensaje)
		   thisform.TipoConsulta= 3
		Endif             
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbmarcas1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.TipoConsulta= 0
		thisform.OldId_Marca=this.Value
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(thisform.vListaPrecios(thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.ListIndex,2), Thisform.Recargo, Thisform.Orden,thisform.TipoConsulta ,thisform.OldId_Marca)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_combobox1.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.Orden= Thisform.vOrden[this.ListIndex,2]
		thisform.TipoConsulta= 2
		
		*** Martin
		thisform.GuardarDistribucion
		*** Martin
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(thisform.vListaPrecios(thisform.Tg_CmbListadePrecios.ListIndex,2), Thisform.Recargo, thisform.Orden ,thisform.TipoConsulta, thisform.OldId_Marca)
		
		thisform.Tg_Textbox1.value= thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click

			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos","Tg_FiltrosPanelArticulos")				
		else
			thisform.oFormFiltrosPanelArticulos.RefrescarControles()			
		Endif

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.InteractiveChange
		local oArch
		
		If Type("this.Value")= "C"
			thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Buscar(alltrim(this.value),.t.,thisform.Orden)
		Else
			thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Buscar(this.value,.t.,thisform.Orden)
		Endif	
		
		if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
			thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrUltimo
		endif
		if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsBof()
			thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrPrimero
		endif
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
		
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		if .f. && lo hace muy lento por ahora
		if nkeycode=5.or.nkeycode=24.or.nkeycode=3.or.nkeycode=18
			do case 
				case nkeycode=5
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Esbof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrAnterior
					 	if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Esbof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrPrimero
					 	endif	
					 	thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					endif 	
			
				case nkeycode=24	
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrSiguiente
						if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrUltimo
						endif	
			
			 			thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					
					endif	
				case nkeycode=18
				
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Esbof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Saltar(-12)
						if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsBof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrPrimero
						endif	
			
			 			thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					
					endif	
					
				case nkeycode=3	
					if !thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
						thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.Saltar(12)
						if thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.EsEof()
					 		thisform.oViewPreciosdeArticulos.IrUltimo
						endif	
			
			 			thisform.tg_grid1.refresh
					
					endif	
			endcase
			mdato=thisform.Aliasarchivo+"."+thisform.vcampos[thisform.tg_combobox1.listindex,1]
			
			this.value=&mDato
		endif	
		endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.Valid
		local mlastkey,mretorna
		
		mlastkey=lastkey()
		mretorna=.t.
		if mlastkey=5.or.mlastkey=24.or. mlastkey=18.or.mlastkey=3
			mretorna=.f.
		endif
		if !mretorna
			keyboard chr(6)
		endif
		return mretorna	
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Top = 135, ;
		Width = 110, ;
		ZOrderSet = 9
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesStock","Tg_ViewComprobantesStock")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oDetalle","tg_tabla","Detalle","Id_Articul")
		thisform.oDetalle.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oStk_Detalle","tg_tabla","Stk_Detalle","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oArticulos","tg_tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oOperarios","tg_tabla","Operarios","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.tg_cmbOperarios1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbOperarios1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Deposito=thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Operario=thisform.Tg_CmbOperarios1.Value
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompStock",thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompStock(thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobanteporsistema
		*** David 9/01 ***********
		
		do case
		   case  thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "V"  && Consulta ventas 
			     If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>T_OBJECT
				    thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		    		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()
			     Else
				    Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		         Endif	
			
		    case thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "C"  && Consulta Compras 
		
		         If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT
				    thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		     		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
		         Else
				    Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
		        Endif	
		
		    Case thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "I"  && Consulta Importacion 
		
		         If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteImportacion")<>T_OBJECT			 
		        	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteImportacion","TG_ConsCompImportacion",thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		         Else
		        	Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteImportacion.ConsultarCompImportacion(thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		         Endif	
		
		         thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteImportacion.Show()
		
		EndCase
		
		*** David 9/01 ************
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,lAnulado,cId_Deposito,cId_Sucursal,cId_Operario,vComprobantesSeleccionados,mmpp,vComprobantes, i
		
		Local cClave, vGrabacion, nTotal
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Dimension vComprobantesSeleccionados[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.Revertir()
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbDepositos1.Value="TD"
			cId_Deposito=""
		Else
			cId_Deposito=ThisForm.Tg_cmbDepositos1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbSucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbOperarios1.Value="TD"
			cId_Operario=""
		Else
			cId_Operario=ThisForm.Tg_cmbDepositos1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=.f.
		
		Dimension vComprobantesSeleccionados[alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesStock1.vItems,1),2]
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesStock1.vItems,vComprobantesSeleccionados)
		i=1
		for mmpp=1 to alen(vComprobantesSeleccionados,1)
		    if substr(vComprobantesSeleccionados[mmpp,1],4)="S"
		       Dimension vComprobantes[i,2]
		       vComprobantes[i,1]=vComprobantesSeleccionados[mmpp,1]
		       vComprobantes[i,2]=vComprobantesSeleccionados[mmpp,2]    
		       i=i+1
		    endif
		next
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Deposito,cId_Sucursal,lAnulado)
		
		* tengo en la vista los comprobantes de stock que cargan operario entre las fechas seleccionadas
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.IrPrimero()
		
		do While !thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.EsEof()
		   if thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Suma")
		      cClave = thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		      Thisform.oStk_Detalle.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		      Do While !Thisform.oStk_Detalle.EsEof() and thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)=cClave
		         if thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Id_Operario")=Thisform.Tg_CmbOperarios1.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbOperarios1.Value="TD"
		            cId_Articulo =  thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		            Thisform.oArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		            if Thisform.oDetalle.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul") 
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"   ,Thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")+thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad"))	
			           Thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		            else
		           	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_articulo",cId_Articulo)	
		               =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"     ,thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Detalle"))
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"   ,thisform.oStk_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad"))	
		         	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"      ,Thisform.oArticulos.Leer("CostoHoraMo")/iif(Thisform.oArticulos.Leer("ProdPorHora")<>0,Thisform.oArticulos.Leer("ProdPorHora"),1))	
		               Thisform.oDetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		            endif
		         endif   
		         Thisform.oStk_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
		      enddo
		   endif
		   thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		nTotal = 0
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		do while !Thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"      ,Thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")*Thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Costo"))
		   Thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   nTotal = nTotal + Thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Total")
		   Thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente()    
		enddo
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = nTotal
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Costo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Total"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [4,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Fechas "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = dtoc(Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value)+" - "+dtoc(Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Código de Operario"
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbOperarios1.Value)
		
		if thisform.Tg_CmbOperarios1.Value="TD"
		   this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Operario"
		   this.vTitulos[3,2] = "Todos"
		else
		   Thisform.oOperarios.Buscar(thisform.Tg_CmbOperarios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		   this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Operario"
		   this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(thisform.oOperarios.Leer("Nombre"))
		endif   
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Total Mano de Obra"
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = Str(thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value,15,2)
		
		dodefault()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbdepositos1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Deposito
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Deposito=this.Value
	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Operario
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Operario=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_SELECCIONARCOMPROBANTESSTOCK1.Init

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_SELECCIONARCOMPROBANTESSTOCK1.interactivechange

		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC
