	PROCEDURE recursivo2
		Lparameters cArticuloMp
		
		Local cId_Articulo, cStringAux, nReg, nCostoReposicion, nCostoActual, nCantidad
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		*!*	if thisform.oTblAux_ConsCostoStockFormulas.Buscar (cArticuloMp, .f., "ID_ARTICUL")
		*!*		** no hago nada porque ya lo tengo a este artículo 
		*!*	else
		*!*		**AQUI GRABO LA CANTIDAD DISPONIBLE Y LOS COSTOS RESPECTIVOS DEL ARTICULO
		*!*		thisform.GrabarDatos (cArticuloMp)
		*!*	endif
			
		nCantidad = Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad") 	
			
		if Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar (cArticuloMp, .f., "CLAVE")
			**ES SEMIELABORADO
			
			**Pregunto si es Mano de Obra, para no ciclar infinito
			if thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar (cArticuloMp, .f., "CLAVE")
				
				if !thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer ("ManodeObra")
				
				   * como no es mano de obra lo agrego en la tabla auxiliar para calcular costo
				   
				   thisform.GrabarDatos(cArticuloMp, nCantidad)
				
					**no es mano de obra, por lo que tengo que seguir ciclando por las fórmulas
					do while !this.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and this.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cArticuloMp
			
						cId_Articulo    = this.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_Articulo")
						cStringAux      = "Recno('" + this.oTblStk_Kits.Alias + "')"
						nReg            = &cStringAux
				
					 	this.Recursivo2 (cId_Articulo)
					 	*Recursivo2 with Stk_Kits.Id_Articulo, nCantidadFinal, Stk_Kits.Id_ArticuloKit, nCosto
						this.oTblStk_Kits.IrRegistro (nReg)
		
						thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente()
					enddo
					
				endif	
				
			endif
			
		endif		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechadesde, dFechaHasta, cId_Articulo, nCantPeriodo, nCantPromedio, vGrabacion
		Local dFechaFabricacion, cId_ArticuloMp, cCantidadMp, dFechaUso, cId_ArticuloPadre
		Local nStockAux, nStockAux2, vComprobantes, vDepositos, cCantidadProduccion, dUltimaFecha, dFechaCalculo, n, nStockAuxSemi, nStockTotalEnSemi
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Thisform.Id_Plan = Thisform.Tg_Prd_PlanCabecera1.Value
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Plan,.f.,"Clave")
		
		i = 0
		Do while !Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.Leer("Id_Plan")=Thisform.Id_Plan
		   i = i + 1
		   Dimension vComprobantes[i,2]
		   vComprobantes[i,1] = Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		   vComprobantes[i,2] = .t.
		   Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.Revertir()
		thisform.oAuxResultados.Revertir()
		Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Revertir()
		Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Revertir()
		Thisform.oAux_Costos.Revertir()
		
		dFechaDesde = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		dFechaHasta = dfechaDesde + Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value - 1
		nCantPeriodo = 0
		
		* piden que si no hay produccion sabados y domingos corra la cantidad de dias
		* guardo en una variable el ultimo dia del plan
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.IrUltimo()
		dUltimaFecha  = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("FechaDesde")   
		dFechaCalculo = dFechaDesde
		
		n = 0
		
		do while n < Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value and dFechaCalculo <= dUltimaFecha
		
		   * primero barro Prd_PlanDetalleFecha viendo lo que voy a producir en el rango
		
		   Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.IrPrimero()
		
		   Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Plan+dtos(dFechaCalculo),.t.,"Fecha")
		   
		   if Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.EsEof() or Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("FechaDesde")<>dFechaCalculo
		   
		      if dow(dFechaCalculo)<>1 and dow(dFechaCalculo)<>7
		         n = n + 1
		      endif
		      dFechaCalculo = dFechaCalculo + 1
		      
		   else
		      
		      Do while !Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("FechaDesde")=dFechaCalculo
		       
		          cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		          dFechaFabricacion = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("FechaDesde")   
		          cCantidadProduccion = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("CantDiaria")   
		          * con el articulo a fabricar me meto en prd_requerimientounitario y llenando la base de lo que necesito
		          * para lo cual uso Prd_PlanDetalle auxiliar
		          
		          * aca intercalo que me grabe en una base auxiliar lo que tengo que fabricar para sacar los semielaborados al final
		          if Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")  
		             =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"     , Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad") + cCantidadProduccion)
		             Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		          else
		             =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , cId_Articulo)       
		             =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , cCantidadProduccion)
		             Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		          endif   
		   
		          Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Plan+cId_Articulo,.f.,"PlanArt")
		          
		          Do while !Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.Leer("Id_ArticuloPadre")=cId_Articulo
		   
		             cId_ArticuloMp = Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.Leer("Id_ArticuloMp")
		             cCantidadMp    = Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.Leer("Cantidad")
		             dFechaUso      = dFechaFabricacion - iif(thisform.Tg_CheckBox1.value,0,Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.Leer("TiempoFason"))
		      
		             * si la fecha de uso esta en el rango sumo lo que necesito en el archivo auxiliar 
		             if dFechaUso >= dFechaDesde &&and dFechaUso <= dFechaHasta
		                =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Plan"     , Thisform.Id_Plan)
		                =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , cId_ArticuloMp)      
		                =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fecha"       , dFechaDesde)
		                =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , cCantidadMp * cCantidadProduccion)         
		                Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		             endif
		      
		             Thisform.oTblPrd_RequerimientoUnitario.IrSiguiente()
		      
		          Enddo
		   
		          Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.IrSiguiente()
		   
		      Enddo
		         
		      n = n + 1
		      dFechaCalculo = dFechaCalculo + 1
		       
		   endif    
		   
		enddo
		     
		    
		* hasta aca llene las necesidades del periodo
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.EsEof()
		
		   cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.Leer("Id_articulo")
		   nCantPeriodo = 0
		   
		   Do While !Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.Leer("Id_articulo")=cId_Articulo
		   
		      nCantPeriodo = nCantPeriodo + Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.Leer("Cantidad")
		       
		      Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.IrSiguiente() 
		       
		   Enddo
		   
		   * ya tengo la cantidad que consumo en el periodo puedo calcular el consumo promedio diario
		   
		   nCantPromedio = nCantPeriodo / Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value 
		   
		   * ahora tengo que ver el stock que tengo y las ordenes de compra pendientes
		   
		   nStockAux2 = 0
		   nStockAux  = 0
		   
		   if thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Buscar (thisform.Id_Plan, .f., "CLAVE")
			  do while !thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Plan") = thisform.Id_Plan
		
				 nStockAux2 = thisform.oSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(cId_Articulo, oApp.CodSucursal(), @vDepositos, thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))
				 nStockAux = nStockAux + nStockAux2
				 thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.IrSiguiente()			
					
			  enddo
			  
			  **EN CASO DE TENER UN ARTICULO CON STOCK NEGATIVO, LO TOMO COMO STOCK 0
			  
			  if nStockAux < 0
				 nStockAux = 0
			  endif
			
		   endif
		   
		   * ahora tengo que armar las ordenes de compras pendientes
		   
		   	thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",oApp.CodSucursal(),ctod("  /  /  "),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(),cId_Articulo,cId_Articulo,"TD ","TD ","TD ",ThisForm.oParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"),1,ctod("  /  /  "),dFechaCalculo-1) 
		   	
		   	nOcPendientes = Thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")
		
		    thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		
		    * aca intercalo ver cuanto del articulo hay en semielaborados
		    
		    if thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")
		    
		       nStockTotalEnSemi = 0
		
		       Do while !thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Leer("Id_articulo")=cId_Articulo
		          
		          cId_ArticuloPadre = thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit")
		          
		          * calculo el stock de este articulo
		          
		          nStockAux2 = 0
		          nStockAuxSemi = 0
		          if thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Buscar (thisform.Id_Plan, .f., "CLAVE")
			         do while !thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Plan") = thisform.Id_Plan
		   		        nStockAux2 = thisform.oSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(cId_ArticuloPadre, oApp.CodSucursal(), @vDepositos, thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))
				        nStockAuxSemi = nStockAuxSemi + nStockAux2
				        thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.IrSiguiente()			
				     enddo
			         **EN CASO DE TENER UN ARTICULO CON STOCK NEGATIVO, LO TOMO COMO STOCK 0
			         if nStockAuxSemi < 0
				        nStockAuxSemi = 0
			         endif
		          endif
		          
		          * acmulador de stock del insumo
		          
		          nStockTotalEnSemi = nStockTotalEnSemi + (nStockAuxSemi * thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Leer("Cantidad"))
		          
		          thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.IrSiguiente()
		          
		       enddo
		       
		    endif
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"    , cId_Articulo)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"         , Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
		    
		    if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("ManoDeObra")
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockInicial"   , nStockAux)      
		    else   
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockInicial"   , nStockTotalEnSemi)      
		    endif   
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Remanente"      , nStockTotalEnSemi)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockNecesario" , nCantPromedio)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "OcPendientes"   , nOcPendientes)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Sugerido"       , iif(nCantPromedio<>0,nStockAux/nCantPromedio,0))
		    Thisform.oAuxResultados.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		    *Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.IrSiguiente()
		    
		Enddo
		
		* ahora me fijo que semielaborados hay en juego en lo que tengo que fabricar
		
		Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.EsEof()
		
		   cId_ArticuloPadre = Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		   
		   * recursivo lleno en oAux_Costos los semielaborados que consume y la cantidad
		   if Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar(cId_ArticuloPadre,.f.,"Clave")
		
		      Thisform.oAux_Costos.Revertir() 
		
		      * barro formula
		      
		      do while !thisform.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cId_ArticuloPadre
				
		         cId_articulo    = thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			     cStringAux      = "Recno('" + this.oTblStk_Kits.Alias + "')"
		  	     nReg            = &cStringAux
			     this.Recursivo2 (cId_Articulo)
			     this.oTblStk_Kits.IrRegistro (nReg)
		
			     thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente()
			  
		      enddo
		   
		   endif
		   
		   *ahora lleno oDetalleSemi con lo que necesito de semielaborados
		   
		   Thisform.oAux_Costos.IrPrimero()
		   Do while !Thisform.oAux_Costos.EsEof()
		   
		      cId_Articulo        = Thisform.oAux_Costos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		      cCantidadProduccion = Thisform.oAux_Costos.Leer("Cantidad") * Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad")
		      
		      if Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"     , Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Cantidad") + cCantidadProduccion)
		         Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		      else
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , cId_Articulo)       
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , cCantidadProduccion)
		         Thisform.oDetalleSemi.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      endif   
		      
		      Thisform.oAux_Costos.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo
		   
		   Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		* ahora barro odetallesemi y grabo auxresultados incorparando el stock que hay
		
		Thisform.oDetalleSemi.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oDetalleSemi.EsEof()
		   cId_Articulo = Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Id_articulo")
		   thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		   nCantPeriodo = Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Cantidad")
		   nCantPromedio = nCantPeriodo / Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value 
		   
		   * busco el stock del articulo
		   nStockAux2 = 0
		   nStockAux  = 0
		   
		   if thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Buscar (thisform.Id_Plan, .f., "CLAVE")
			  do while !thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Plan") = thisform.Id_Plan
		
				 nStockAux2 = thisform.oSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(cId_Articulo, oApp.CodSucursal(), @vDepositos, thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))
				 nStockAux = nStockAux + nStockAux2
				 thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.IrSiguiente()			
					
			  enddo
			  
			  **EN CASO DE TENER UN ARTICULO CON STOCK NEGATIVO, LO TOMO COMO STOCK 0
			  
			  if nStockAux < 0
				 nStockAux = 0
			  endif
			
		   endif
		
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"    , cId_Articulo)      
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"         , Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockInicial"   , nStockAux)      
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockNecesario" , nCantPromedio)      
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Sugerido"       , iif(nCantPromedio<>0,nStockAux/nCantPromedio,0))
		   Thisform.oAuxResultados.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		   
		   Thisform.oDetalleSemi.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oAuxResultados.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta1
		Local dFechadesde, dFechaHasta, cId_Articulo, nCantPeriodo, nCantPromedio, vGrabacion
		Local dFechaFabricacion, cId_ArticuloMp, cCantidadMp, dFechaUso, cId_ArticuloPadre
		Local nStockAux, nStockAux2, vComprobantes, vDepositos, cCantidadProduccion, dUltimaFecha, dFechaCalculo, n, nStockAuxSemi, nStockTotalEnSemi
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Thisform.Id_Plan = Thisform.Tg_Prd_PlanCabecera1.Value
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Plan,.f.,"Clave")
		
		i = 0
		Do while !Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.Leer("Id_Plan")=Thisform.Id_Plan
		   i = i + 1
		   Dimension vComprobantes[i,2]
		   vComprobantes[i,1] = Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		   vComprobantes[i,2] = .t.
		   Thisform.oTblPrd_CmptPendientes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleAuxiliar.Revertir()
		thisform.oAuxResultados.Revertir()
		Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Revertir()
		Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Revertir()
		Thisform.oAux_Costos.Revertir()
		
		dFechaDesde = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		dFechaHasta = dfechaDesde + Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value - 1
		nCantPeriodo = 0
		
		* piden que si no hay produccion sabados y domingos corra la cantidad de dias
		* guardo en una variable el ultimo dia del plan
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.IrUltimo()
		dUltimaFecha  = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanDetalleFecha.Leer("FechaDesde")   
		dFechaCalculo = dFechaDesde
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.IrPrimero()
		      
		do while !Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.EsEof()
		      
		   cId_Articulo        = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		   cCantidadProduccion = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.Leer("Cantidad")   
		   
		   * con el articulo a fabricar me meto en prd_requerimientounitario y llenando la base de lo que necesito
		   * para lo cual uso Prd_PlanDetalle auxiliar
		          
		   * aca intercalo que me grabe en una base auxiliar lo que tengo que fabricar para sacar los semielaborados al final
		   
		   if Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")  
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"     , Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad") + cCantidadProduccion)
		      Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   else
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , cId_Articulo)       
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , cCantidadProduccion)
		      Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		   endif   
		   
		   Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.IrSiguiente()
		enddo     
		
		* armo la base de semielaborados de todo el plan
		
		thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.EsEof()
		
		   cId_ArticuloPadre = Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		   
		   * recursivo lleno en oAux_Costos los semielaborados que consume y la cantidad
		   if Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar(cId_ArticuloPadre,.f.,"Clave")
		
		      Thisform.oAux_Costos.Revertir() 
		
		      * barro formula
		      
		      do while !thisform.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cId_ArticuloPadre
				
		         cId_articulo    = thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			     cStringAux      = "Recno('" + this.oTblStk_Kits.Alias + "')"
		  	     nReg            = &cStringAux
			     this.Recursivo2 (cId_Articulo)
			     this.oTblStk_Kits.IrRegistro (nReg)
		
			     thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente()
			  
		      enddo
		   
		   endif
		   
		   *ahora lleno oDetalleSemi con lo que necesito de semielaborados
		   
		   Thisform.oAux_Costos.IrPrimero()
		   Do while !Thisform.oAux_Costos.EsEof()
		   
		      cId_Articulo        = Thisform.oAux_Costos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		      cCantidadProduccion = Thisform.oAux_Costos.Leer("Cantidad") * Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad")
		      
		      if Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"     , Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Cantidad") + cCantidadProduccion)
		         Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		      else
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , cId_Articulo)       
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , cCantidadProduccion)
		         Thisform.oDetalleSemi.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      endif   
		      
		      Thisform.oAux_Costos.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo
		   
		   Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		    
		* hasta aca llene las necesidades del periodo de semielaborados
		
		* ahora me meto en la formula de cada semielaborado y lleno la base con los insumos y uso de nuevo oDetallefabricar que tiene indice por articulo
		* pero al meterme voy a volver a meter los semielaborados asi que despues tengo que borrarlos
		Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Revertir()
		
		Thisform.oDetalleSemi.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !Thisform.oDetalleSemi.EsEof()
		
		   cId_Articulo = Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Id_articulo")
		   nCantPeriodo = Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Cantidad")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		   
		   Do While !Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articuloKit")=cId_Articulo
		
		      if Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Buscar(Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articulo"),.f.,"Id_Articul")  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"     , Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad") + (nCantPeriodo * Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad")))
		         Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		      else
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articulo"))       
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , nCantPeriodo * Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad"))
		         Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      endif   
		   
		      Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente() 
		       
		   Enddo
		   
		   Thisform.oDetalleSemi.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		* borro los semielabaorados que meti
		
		Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.EsEof()
		
		   cId_Articulo = Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Id_articulo")
		   
		   if Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")
		         
		      Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Borrar()
		      
		   endif
		       
		   Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		* ahora barro los articulo a fabricar para sacar sus componentes pero si aparece un articulo semielaborado que esta en oDetalleSemi lo ignoro
		* los saco de prd_planalternativo
		
		Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.EsEof()
		
		   cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.Leer("Id_articulo")
		   nCantPeriodo = Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.Leer("Cantidad")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		   
		   Do While !Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articuloKit")=cId_Articulo
		   
		      if !Thisform.oDetalleSemi.buscar(Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articulo"),.f.,"Id_Articul") && implica que no es un semielaborado
		        
		         if Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Buscar(Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articulo"),.f.,"Id_Articul")  
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"     , Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad") + (nCantPeriodo * Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad")))
		            Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         else  
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo" , Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_articulo"))       
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"    , nCantPeriodo * Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad"))
		            Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		         endif   
		         
		      endif   
		   
		      Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente() 
		       
		   Enddo
		      
		   Thisform.oTblPrd_PlanAlternativo.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		* armo la tabla de datos ya que tengo todo los insumos cargados
		
		Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrPrimero()
		   
		Do while !Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.EsEof()
		   
		   * ya tengo la cantidad que consumo en el periodo puedo calcular el consumo promedio diario
		
		   cId_Articulo  = Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		   nCantPromedio = Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.Leer("Cantidad") / Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value 
		
		  
		   * ahora tengo que ver el stock que tengo y las ordenes de compra pendientes
		   
		   nStockAux2 = 0
		   nStockAux  = 0
		   
		   if thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Buscar (thisform.Id_Plan, .f., "CLAVE")
			  do while !thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Plan") = thisform.Id_Plan
		
				 nStockAux2 = thisform.oSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(cId_Articulo, oApp.CodSucursal(), @vDepositos, thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))
				 nStockAux = nStockAux + nStockAux2
				 thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.IrSiguiente()			
					
			  enddo
			  
			  **EN CASO DE TENER UN ARTICULO CON STOCK NEGATIVO, LO TOMO COMO STOCK 0
			  
			  if nStockAux < 0
				 nStockAux = 0
			  endif
			
		   endif
		   
		   * ahora tengo que armar las ordenes de compras pendientes
		   
		   	thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",oApp.CodSucursal(),ctod("  /  /  "),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(),cId_Articulo,cId_Articulo,"TD ","TD ","TD ",ThisForm.oParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"),1,ctod("  /  /  "),Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value+Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value) 
		   	
		   	nOcPendientes = Thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")
		
		    thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		
		    * aca intercalo ver cuanto del articulo hay en semielaborados
		    
		    if thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Id_Articul")
		    
		       nStockTotalEnSemi = 0
		
		       Do while !thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Leer("Id_articulo")=cId_Articulo
		          
		          cId_ArticuloPadre = thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit")
		          
		          * calculo el stock de este articulo
		          
		          nStockAux2 = 0
		          nStockAuxSemi = 0
		          if thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Buscar (thisform.Id_Plan, .f., "CLAVE")
			         do while !thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Plan") = thisform.Id_Plan
		   		        nStockAux2 = thisform.oSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(cId_ArticuloPadre, oApp.CodSucursal(), @vDepositos, thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))
				        nStockAuxSemi = nStockAuxSemi + nStockAux2
				        thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.IrSiguiente()			
				     enddo
			         **EN CASO DE TENER UN ARTICULO CON STOCK NEGATIVO, LO TOMO COMO STOCK 0
			         if nStockAuxSemi < 0
				        nStockAuxSemi = 0
			         endif
		          endif
		          
		          * acmulador de stock del insumo
		          
		          nStockTotalEnSemi = nStockTotalEnSemi + (nStockAuxSemi * thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.Leer("Cantidad"))
		          
		          thisform.oTblStk_KitsHijos.IrSiguiente()
		          
		       enddo
		       
		    endif
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"    , cId_Articulo)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"         , Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
		    
		    if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("ManoDeObra")
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockInicial"   , nStockAux)      
		    else   
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockInicial"   , nStockTotalEnSemi)      
		    endif   
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Remanente"      , nStockTotalEnSemi)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockNecesario" , nCantPromedio)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "OcPendientes"   , nOcPendientes)      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Sugerido"       , iif(nCantPromedio<>0,nStockAux/nCantPromedio,0))
		    Thisform.oAuxResultados.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		    Thisform.oDetalleFabricar.IrSiguiente()
		    
		Enddo
		
		
		* ahora barro odetallesemi y grabo auxresultados incorparando el stock que hay
		
		Thisform.oDetalleSemi.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oDetalleSemi.EsEof()
		   cId_Articulo = Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Id_articulo")
		   thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		   nCantPeriodo = Thisform.oDetalleSemi.Leer("Cantidad")
		   nCantPromedio = nCantPeriodo / Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value 
		   
		   * busco el stock del articulo
		   nStockAux2 = 0
		   nStockAux  = 0
		   
		   if thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Buscar (thisform.Id_Plan, .f., "CLAVE")
			  do while !thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.EsEof() and thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Plan") = thisform.Id_Plan
		
				 nStockAux2 = thisform.oSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(cId_Articulo, oApp.CodSucursal(), @vDepositos, thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))
				 nStockAux = nStockAux + nStockAux2
				 thisform.oTblPrd_Depositos.IrSiguiente()			
					
			  enddo
			  
			  **EN CASO DE TENER UN ARTICULO CON STOCK NEGATIVO, LO TOMO COMO STOCK 0
			  
			  if nStockAux < 0
				 nStockAux = 0
			  endif
			
		   endif
		
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"    , cId_Articulo)      
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"         , Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockInicial"   , nStockAux)      
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockNecesario" , nCantPromedio)      
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Sugerido"       , iif(nCantPromedio<>0,nStockAux/nCantPromedio,0))
		   Thisform.oAuxResultados.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		   
		   Thisform.oDetalleSemi.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oAuxResultados.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".StockInicial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".StockNecesario"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".OcPendientes"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".Sugerido"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oAuxResultados.Alias+".Remanente"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_checkbox1.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled = .t.
		Thisform.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_checkbox2.Click
		Thisform.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled = .t.
		Thisform.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		if !Thisform.Tg_CheckBox2.Value
		   Thisform.refrescarconsulta()
		else
		   Thisform.refrescarconsulta1()
		endif   
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		if type("thisform.oPlanAlternativo")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oPlanalternativo","TG_AbmArticulosPlanAlternativo")
		Endif
		
		thisform.oPlanalternativo.Show()
		thisform.oPlanAlternativo=""
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_prd_plancabecera1.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled = .t.
		Thisform.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox2.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled = .t.
		Thisform.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled = .f.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder

	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_label2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_label3" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_label4" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_label1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oChkArtAReponer" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="oCmdEjecutarConsulta" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	PROCEDURE armartextofiltrodepositos
		*** LUCHO M. 04-10-10
		local lPri,mmpp,lHayDestildado
		
		thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos = ""
		lPri = .t.
		lHayDestildado = .f.
		
		for mmpp=1 to alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems,1)
			if ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems[mmpp,2] = .t.
		
				if lPri <> .t.
					thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos = thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos + ", "
				else
					lPri = .f.
				endif
			
				thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems[mmpp,1],.f.,"Clave")
			
				thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos = thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos + allt(thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre"))
			else
				lHayDestildado = .t.
			endif
		endfor
		
		if !lHayDestildado
			thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos = "Todos"
		endif
		*** LUCHO M. 04-10-10
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Articulo,lSinStock
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		
		**** Pablo  23/06/2010 ********
		ThisForm.AddObject("oParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		*******************************
		
		***Diego 23-02-09
		***thisform.AddObject("oViewStockGralStock","Tg_ViewStockStockGral")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStockGralStock","Tg_ViewStockStockGralDepo")
		***Diego 23-02-09
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblDepositos","Tg_Tabla","Depositos","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Alias
		
		
		if Type("cId_Articulo")= "L"
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		else
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.enabled	= .f.  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.enabled	= .f.  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.value		= cId_Articulo  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value		= cId_Articulo  
		   ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value 		=	lSinStock
		endif   
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.Value = "TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_Deposito =     thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Marca    =     thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Rubro    =     thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value
		thisform.OldId_SubRubro =     thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta = Space(15)
		thisform.OldArtSinStock =     ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value
		thisform.OldArtAReponer =     ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value
		
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		* ripples solo negativos
		thisform.OldSoloNegativos =   ThisForm.oChkSoloNegativos.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.CurrentControl="CmdTalleColor"
		
		**** Diego 19/02/07
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.CurrentControl="CmdLote"
		****Diego 19/02/07
		
		
		
		if Type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrararticulolote
		LParameters cId_Articulo
		
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lotea")
					
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsStocklote")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsStocklote","TG_ConsStockGralStocklote")				
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmConsStocklote.Consultar(thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,cId_Articulo,ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value,.t.)			
		
			thisform.oFrmConsStocklote.Show()
			
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrararticulotallecolor
		LParameters cId_Articulo
		
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		If !Empty(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_GrupoTalle")) And !Empty(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_GrupoColor"))
					
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsStockTalleColor")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsStockTalleColor","TG_ConsStockGralStockTalleColor")				
			Endif

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Articulo,lSinStock
		
		
		if Type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.value= cId_Articulo  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value= cId_Articulo
		   ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value = lSinStock
		endif   
		
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		* edgardo pase tasas ivas
		* ripples le agrgue al refrescar el oChkSoloNegativos en los parametros
		
		*** Diego 23-02-2009
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems,vDepositos)
		
		***thisform.oViewComprobantesStock.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Deposito,cId_Sucursal,lAnulado)
		
		
		thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Refrescar(@vDepositos,thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value,ThisForm.oChkSoloNegativos.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
	ENDPROC

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Alias+".Stock"

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Alias+".Codigo_Barras"
		
		
		Thisform.oTbxCantTotalArt.Value = Thisform.oViewStockGralStock.Sumar("Stock", ".T.")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		**** Pablo 22/06/2010 *****
		Local cantdepositos, mmpp, cId_Deposito
		cantdepositos = 0
		For mmpp = 1 to Alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems, 1)
		If ThisForm.Tg_Seleccionardeposito1.vItems[mmpp,2]
			cantdepositos = cantdepositos + 1
			cId_Deposito = ThisForm.Tg_SeleccionarDeposito1.vItems[mmpp,1]
		EndIf
		EndFor
		
		If cantdepositos = 1 AND ThisForm.oParametros.Leer("MuestraMovimientosStock")
			thisform.MostrarMovimientos(cId_Deposito)
		Else
			thisform.MostrarStockDeposito
		EndIf
		*!*	*********
		*thisform.MostrarStockDeposito
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		LParameters cId_Deposito,cId_Marca,cId_Rubro,cId_SubRubro,cId_Articulo,lArtSinStock,lArtAReponer,lOcultar
		
		
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=cId_Articulo
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=cId_Articulo
		ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value = cId_Articulo
		ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value = cId_Articulo
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value = cId_Deposito
		thisform.OldId_Deposito					= cId_Deposito
		ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value 	= lArtSinStock
		thisform.OldArtSinStock					=	lArtSinStock
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.Value 		= cId_Marca
		thisform.OldId_Marca						= cId_Marca
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbrubros1.Value 		=	cId_Rubro
		thisform.OldId_Rubro						=	cId_Rubro
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value = cId_SubRubro
		thisform.OldId_SubRubro					= cId_SubRubro
		ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value 	= lArtAReponer
		thisform.OldArtAReponer					= lArtAReponer
		
		
		Thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStockGralStockLote","Tg_ViewStockStockGralLote")
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		
		
		
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=""
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=""
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.Value="TD"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrardeposito
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito","TG_ConsStockDepositoStockLote")				
		Endif
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito.ConsultarStockDeposito(thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Leer("Id_Articulo"),,thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Leer("Id_Lote"))			
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Id_lote"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Saldo2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Merma"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Merma2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Saldo_Sin_Merma"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Saldo_Sin_Merma2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		
		***thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockLote.Alias+".Stock"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkArtAReponer.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtAReponer
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtAReponer=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkArtSinStock.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtSinStock
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtSinStock=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		local vVectorAux
		
		*!*	Dimension vVectorAux [1,2]
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Código de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value)) 
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Razón Social de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.RazonSocial.Value)) 
		
		Dimension this.vTitulos [8,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Depósito: "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.DisplayValue)
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Marca: "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Rubro: "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "SubRubro: "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[5,1] = "Artículo Desde: "
		this.vTitulos[5,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[6,1] = "Artículo Hasta: "
		this.vTitulos[6,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[7,1] = "Artículos sin Stock: "
		if thisform.ochkArtSinStock.Value
			cAux1 = 'SI'
		else
			cAux1 = 'NO'
		endif
		this.vTitulos[7,2] = alltrim(cAux1)
		
		
		this.vTitulos[8,1] = "Sólo Artículos a Reponer: "
		if thisform.ochkArtAReponer.Value
			cAux1 = 'SI'
		else
			cAux1 = 'NO'
		endif
		this.vTitulos[8,2] = alltrim(cAux1)
		
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE copiargrilla
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.Seleccionar()
		
		ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.IrPrimero
		Do While !ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.EsEof()
		
			Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.FijarTag("Clave")
			If Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Buscar(ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.Leer("Id_Articulo"), .F., "CLAVE")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Stock"			,ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.Leer("Stock"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"item"				,0)
				thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Modificar(@vGrabacion)
			Else
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_Articulo"		,ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			,ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.Leer("Nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Stock"			,ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.Leer("Stock"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"item"				,0)
				Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			Endif
			
			ThisForm.oViewStockMemo.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.FijarTag("Item")
		Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Order("Item")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciargrilla
		Local mmpp, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Revertir()
		
		For mmpp= 1 to 500
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Item",mmpp)
			thisform.oTblAux_Stock.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		Endfor
			
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Alias
		Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.IrPrimero
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Articulo,lSinStock
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStockMemo"		,"Tg_ViewStockStockMemorizador")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock"	,"Tg_SistemaStock")
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oParametros"		,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"		,"Tg_Tabla","Articulos"	,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblDepositos"		,"Tg_Tabla","Depositos"	,"Clave")
		*thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Stock" 		,"Tg_Tabla","Aux_StockGral", "CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Stock" 		,"Tg_Tabla","Aux_StockGral")
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Revertir()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockMemo.Alias
		
		
		if Type("cId_Articulo")= "L"
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		else
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.enabled	= .f.  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.enabled	= .f.  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.value		= cId_Articulo  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value		= cId_Articulo  
		   ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value 		= lSinStock
		endif   
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.Value = "001"
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.Value    = "TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_Deposito =     thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Marca    =     thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Rubro    =     thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value
		thisform.OldId_SubRubro =     thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta = Space(15)
		thisform.OldArtSinStock =     ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value
		thisform.OldArtAReponer =     ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value
		
		thisform.OldSoloNegativos =   ThisForm.oChkSoloNegativos.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ReadOnly = .F.
		
		Thisform.IniciarGrilla()
		
		If Type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		LParameters cId_deposito
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos","TG_ConsStockMovimientos")				
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos.MostrarMovimientos(thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Leer("Id_Articulo"),cId_Deposito)
		thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarstockdeposito
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito","TG_ConsStockDepositoStock")				
		Endif
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito.ConsultarStockDeposito(thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Leer("Id_Articulo"))			
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito.Show()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1 .and. !thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.enabled
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		*thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Articulo,lSinStock
		
		
		if Type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.value= cId_Articulo  
		   thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value= cId_Articulo
		   ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value = lSinStock
		endif   
		
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarmarcas1.vItems,vMarcas)
		
		
		
		
		thisform.oViewStockMemo.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value,ThisForm.oChkSoloNegativos.Value,@vMarcas)
		
		Thisform.CopiarGrilla()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Alias+".Stock"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validararticulorepetido
		lParameters cId_Articulo
		Local nRepetido
		
		nRepetido = 0
		
		ThisForm.oTblAux_Stock.IrPrimero
		Do While !ThisForm.oTblAux_Stock.EsEof() And nRepetido = 2
			
			If Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Leer("Id_Articulo") = cId_Articulo
				nRepetido = nRepetido + 1
			Endif
			
			ThisForm.oTblAux_Stock.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		If nRepetido = 2
			Return(.t.)
		Else
			Return(.f.)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkArtAReponer.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtAReponer
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtAReponer=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkArtSinStock.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtSinStock
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtSinStock=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSoloNegativos.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtAReponer
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtAReponer=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		
		Local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		local vVectorAux,lPri,mmpp
		
		
		Dimension this.vTitulos [9,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Seleccionar()
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Filtrar("!Empty(Id_Articulo)")
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.IrPrimero()
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Stock Total: " 										
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = STR(thisform.oViewStockMemo.Sumar("Stock", "1=1"),10,2)
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Depósito: "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = thisform.TextoFiltroDepositos 							
		
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Marca: "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Rubro: "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[5,1] = "SubRubro: "
		this.vTitulos[5,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[6,1] = "Artículo Desde: "
		this.vTitulos[6,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[7,1] = "Artículo Hasta: "
		this.vTitulos[7,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[8,1] = "Artículos sin Stock: "
		if thisform.ochkArtSinStock.Value
			cAux1 = 'SI'
		else
			cAux1 = 'NO'
		endif
		this.vTitulos[8,2] = alltrim(cAux1)
		
		
		this.vTitulos[9,1] = "Sólo Artículos a Reponer: "
		if thisform.ochkArtAReponer.Value
			cAux1 = 'SI'
		else
			cAux1 = 'NO'
		endif
		
		this.vTitulos[9,2] = alltrim(cAux1)
		
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.DesFiltrar()
		thisform.oTblAux_Stock.IrPrimero()

		thisform.BuscaArticulos=.t.
		Dodefault("Inactivo=.f.")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Tg_articulos1.Valid
		Local nStock
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If Thisform.OldId_Articulo <> This.Value
			nStock = 0
		
			nStock = Thisform.oCstSistemaStock.ConsultarStock(this.value,oApp.CodSucursal(),,ThisForm.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value)
			
			*thisform.oTblAux_Stock.IrRegistro(Thisform.Renglon)
		
			If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(This.Value, .F., "CLAVE")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Stock"			,nStock)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			,ThisForm.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"item"				,0)
				Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)			
			Else
				=fMensAceptar("El artículo no existe.")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"		,Thisform.OldId_Articulo)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Stock"			,0)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			,"")
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"item"				,99999)		
				Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)			
			Endif
		Endif
		
		
		*Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.FijarTag("Item")
		*Thisform.oTblAux_Stock.Order("Item")
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Tg_articulos1.When
		
		If !thisform.BuscaArticulos  or Type("Thisform.OldId_Articulo")<>Type("this.value")
			thisform.OldId_Articulo=this.value
		Endif	
		
		thisform.BuscaArticulos=.f.
	ENDPROC

		thisform.MostrarMovimientos(ThisForm.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarMovimientos(ThisForm.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value)
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		LParameters cId_Deposito,cId_Marca,cId_Rubro,cId_SubRubro,cId_Articulo,lArtSinStock,lArtAReponer,lOcultar
		
		
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=cId_Articulo
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=cId_Articulo
		ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value = cId_Articulo
		ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value = cId_Articulo
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbdepositos1.Value = cId_Deposito
		thisform.OldId_Deposito					= cId_Deposito
		ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value 	= lArtSinStock
		thisform.OldArtSinStock					=	lArtSinStock
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.Value 		= cId_Marca
		thisform.OldId_Marca						= cId_Marca
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbrubros1.Value 		=	cId_Rubro
		thisform.OldId_Rubro						=	cId_Rubro
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value = cId_SubRubro
		thisform.OldId_SubRubro					= cId_SubRubro
		ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value 	= lArtAReponer
		thisform.OldArtAReponer					= lArtAReponer
		
		
		Thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStockGralStockTalleColor","Tg_ViewStockStockGralTalleColor")
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		
		
		
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=""
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=""
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDepositos1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbMarcas1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbRubros1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbSubRubros1.Value="TD"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrardeposito
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito","TG_ConsStockDepositoStockTalleColor")				
		Endif
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito.ConsultarStockDeposito(thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Leer("Id_Articulo"),,thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Leer("Id_Talle"),thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Leer("Id_Color"))			
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaStockDeposito.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtSinStock.Value,ThisForm.oChkArtAReponer.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias+".NomTalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias+".NomColor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockGralStockTalleColor.Alias+".Stock"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkArtAReponer.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtAReponer
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtAReponer=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkArtSinStock.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldArtSinStock
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldArtSinStock=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxArticuloHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		local vVectorAux
		
		*!*	Dimension vVectorAux [1,2]
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Código de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value)) 
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Razón Social de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.RazonSocial.Value)) 
		
		Dimension this.vTitulos [8,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Depósito: "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.DisplayValue)
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Marca: "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Rubro: "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "SubRubro: "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.DisplayValue)
		
		this.vTitulos[5,1] = "Artículo Desde: "
		this.vTitulos[5,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[6,1] = "Artículo Hasta: "
		this.vTitulos[6,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value)
		
		this.vTitulos[7,1] = "Artículos sin Stock: "
		if thisform.ochkArtSinStock.Value
			cAux1 = 'SI'
		else
			cAux1 = 'NO'
		endif
		this.vTitulos[7,2] = alltrim(cAux1)
		
		
		this.vTitulos[8,1] = "Sólo Artículos a Reponer: "
		if thisform.ochkArtAReponer.Value
			cAux1 = 'SI'
		else
			cAux1 = 'NO'
		endif
		this.vTitulos[8,2] = alltrim(cAux1)
		
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas","Tg_Tabla","Marcas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros","Tg_Tabla","Rubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubRubros","Tg_Tabla","SubRubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDepositos","Tg_Tabla","Depositos","Clave")
		
		thisform.oTblParametros.IrPrimero()
		if thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex") = 0 or empty(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex"))
			thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		else
			thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema() - thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex")
		endif	
		
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStkMovimientos","Tg_ViewStkMovimientos")
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(7,8,0,0,0)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompStock",thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompStock(thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		lParameters cId_Articulo,cId_deposito
		
		thisform.id_Articulo=cId_Articulo
		thisform.id_deposito=cId_deposito
		
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(thisform.Id_articulo)
		thisform.oTblMarcas.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca"))
		thisform.oTblRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro"))
		thisform.oTblSubRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_SubRubro"))
		thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(cId_Deposito)
		
		ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre") +"   "+"("+alltrim(thisform.Id_Articulo)+")" 
		ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreDeposito.Caption=thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		&&thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Refrescar(thisform.Id_Articulo,thisform.Id_Deposito,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".NombreSistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".CantidadEntrada"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".CantidadSalida"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".Saldo"
		** Matias L. 11/05/2020
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".NombreComprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientos.Alias+".detalle"
		** Matias L. 11/05/2020
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_COMMANDBUTTON1.Click
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas","Tg_Tabla","Marcas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros","Tg_Tabla","Rubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubRubros","Tg_Tabla","SubRubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDepositos","Tg_Tabla","Depositos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblTalles","Tg_Tabla","Talles","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblColores","Tg_Tabla","Colores","Clave")
		
		thisform.oTblParametros.IrPrimero()
		if thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex") = 0 or empty(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex"))
			thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		else
			thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema() - thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex")
		endif	
		
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		Thisform.Ocultar=.t.
		
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStkMovimientoslote","Tg_ViewStkMovimientoslote")
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(7,8,0,0,0)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompStock",thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompStock(thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		lParameters cId_Articulo,cId_deposito,cId_Lote
		
		thisform.id_Articulo=cId_Articulo
		thisform.id_deposito=cId_deposito
		Thisform.Id_Lote=cId_Lote
		
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(thisform.Id_articulo)
		thisform.oTblMarcas.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca"))
		thisform.oTblRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro"))
		thisform.oTblSubRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_SubRubro"))
		thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(cId_Deposito)
		
		ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=Alltrim(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")) +"   "+"("+alltrim(thisform.Id_Articulo)+")" 
		ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreDeposito.Caption=thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblTalle.Caption=cid_lote
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Refrescar(thisform.Id_Articulo,thisform.Id_Deposito,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,Thisform.Id_lote)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias
		
		if ThisForm.Tg_optiongroup1.value = 1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".NombreSistema"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Nro_externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Fecha"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadEntrada"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadSalida"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Saldo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadEntradaMerma"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadSalidaMerma"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".SaldoMerma"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Saldo"+ "-"+ thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".SaldoMerma"
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.header1.caption = "Ent Merma"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.header1.caption = "Sal. Merma"
		  	thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.header1.caption = "Saldo Merma"
		else
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".NombreSistema"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Nro_externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Fecha"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadEntrada2"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadSalida2"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Saldo2"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadEntradaMerma2"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".CantidadSalidaMerma2"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".SaldoMerma2"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".Saldo2"+ "-"+ thisform.oViewStkMovimientoslote.Alias+".SaldoMerma2"	
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.header1.caption = "Ent Merma"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.header1.caption = "Sal. Merma"
		  	thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.header1.caption = "Saldo Merma"
		
		
		endif
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [4,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Nombre de Articulo: "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Deposito: "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(ThisForm.oLblNombreDeposito.Caption)+Space(3)+"("+thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Id_Deposito")+")"
		
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Fecha Desde: "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(dtoc(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value))
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Fecha Hasta: "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(dtoc(ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value))
		
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_COMMANDBUTTON1.Click
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.Click
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		Endif	
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
