	PROCEDURE calcularvariacionpromedio
		Local nTotalPrecioactual, nTotalPrecioNuevo, nVariacionPromedio, nRegistro
		
		nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Recno()
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		nTotalPrecioactual = 0
		nTotalPrecioNuevo = 0
		
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
		   nTotalPrecioActual = nTotalPrecioActual + Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual")
		   nTotalPrecioNuevo = nTotalPrecioNuevo + Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		nVariacionPromedio = Round(((nTotalPrecioNuevo / nTotalPrecioActual) - 1) * 100, 5)
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = nVariacionPromedio
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Precios","tg_tabla","Aux_Precios")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","tg_tabla","Articulos","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_ArtProve","tg_tabla","Cmp_ArtProve","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oSistemaStock","Tg_sistemastock")
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Revertir()
		
		*cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		cMascaraDatos = "999999.99999"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		*thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		*Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarfechaSistema()
		
		Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value = 0
		
		**** 17-01-2014
		if Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("actualiza_cmp_artprove")
			Thisform.Tg_Checkbox1.Value = .t.
			Thisform.Tg_Checkbox1.enabled  = .f.
		Endif
		**** 17-01-2014
		
		*Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.IrPrimero()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Articulo, cNombre, nPrecio
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Revertir()
		
		if thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = space(15)
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Marca = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Marca = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Rubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_SubRubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Clave")
		else
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		   
		* barro los articulos y lleno la tabla auxiliar con los que van a lista de precios
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		
		   if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		      cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		      cNombre = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		      cId_Marca = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca")
		      cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		      cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		      if cId_Articulo >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                   and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                   and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                   and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		         nPrecio = 0
		      
		         Thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto"),.f.,"Clave")   
		      
		         nPrecio = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Costo")   
		      
		         if alltrim(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value) = ""
		      
			        =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"        	,	cId_Articulo )
			        =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			        ,	cNombre ) 
			        =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioActual"        	,	nPrecio )
			        =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	0 )
			        =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"         	,	nPrecio )	  
			        =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Moneda"                 ,   Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo") )	  
			        thisform.oTblAux_Precios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			        
			     else   
			     
			        if Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value+cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave") 
		   	           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"        	,	cId_Articulo )
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			        ,	cNombre ) 
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioActual"        	,	nPrecio )
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	0 )
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"         	,	nPrecio )	  
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Moneda"                 ,   Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo") )	  
			           thisform.oTblAux_Precios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			        endif
			        
		         endif
		         
		      endif
		            
		   endif
		   
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local cMscaraDatos
		
		*cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		*cMascaraDatos = "999999.99999"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".PrecioActual"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Variacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".PrecioNuevo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Moneda"
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		*thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion, dFecha, cId_Lista, lCmp_ArtProve, nPrecio, nBoni, nPrecioLista
		
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		lCmp_ArtProve = Thisform.Tg_Checkbox1.Value
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
		   if Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") <> Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		   
		      * Busco el articulo en articulos
		      
		         if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")       
		         
		         	If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Costo") <> Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		         		 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_CambioCosto" ,	Date())   
		         	Endif
		         
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"           	,	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo") )         
		            thisform.oTblArticulos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
				 	If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("ActualizaPrecioDesdeCosto")         
			        	Thisform.oSistemaStock.ActualizarPrecioVenta(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"),Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo"),Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("id_monedacosto"),,"",Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_ListaPreciosActualiza"))
			        Endif
		         endif
		     
		   endif
		   
		   if alltrim(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value)<>""
		      if lCmp_ArtProve
		         if Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value + Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")
		            nPrecio      = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		            nBoni        = Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Leer("Bonificacion")
		            nPrecioLista = nPrecio / ( 1 - (nBoni/100)) 
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Precio"  	 , nPrecio)                     
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Bonificacion" , nBoni)                     
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PrecioLista"	 , nPrecioLista)                                             
		            thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)            
		         endif
		      endif
		   endif
		
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		
		
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
		
		=fMensAceptar("Se realizaron los cambios solicitados")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.Valid
		Local nPrecioNuevo, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*if this.value<>0
		
		   nPrecioNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * This.Value /100),5)
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
		*endif
		
		Thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		
		return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		Local nVariacion, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if This.value = 0
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"variacion"        	,	0 )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		   
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		if (this.value / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")) - 1 < 10
		   nVariacion = Round(((this.value / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")) - 1) * 100, 2)
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"        	,	nVariacion )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		   
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		
		return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		
		Thisform.oProveedores.Buscar(This.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.Tg_Label3.Caption = Thisform.oProveedores.Leer("Razon_Social")
		
		dodefault()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.InteractiveChange
		Local nRegistro, nPrecioNuevo
		
		nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.recno()
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
		   if Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") <> 0
		      nPrecioNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value /100),5)
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value )
		      thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   endif
		   
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		
		thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas"		,"tg_tabla","Monedas"		,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"		,"tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Precios"	,"tg_tabla","Aux_Precios")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"		,"tg_tabla","Articulos"		,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_ArtProve"		,"tg_tabla","Cmp_ArtProve"	,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oProveedores"		,"tg_tabla","Proveedores"	,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_AlicuotasIvas"	,"tg_tabla","Vnt_alicuotasivas","clave")
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Revertir()
		
		cMascaraDatos = "999999.99999"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde = Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca		  = Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro		  = Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro	  = Space(3)
		
		Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value = 0
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Articulo, cNombre, nPrecio, nPrecioNuevo, vGrabacion,nPrecioListaViejo , nPrecioListaNuevo, NprecioVenta , Nporc_iva
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Revertir()
		
		if thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = space(15)
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Marca = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Marca = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Rubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_SubRubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Clave")
		else
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		
		If alltrim(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value) = "" or !thisform.oProveedores.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
			=fMensAceptar("Debe Seleccionar un Proveedor o un Codigo de Proveedor Existente")
			Retu
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		
		
		
		do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		
		   if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		      cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		      cNombre = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		      cId_Marca = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca")
		      cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		      cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		      if cId_Articulo >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                   and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                   and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                   and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		         nPrecio = 0
		      
		         Thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto"),.f.,"Clave")   
		      
		     
			        if Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value+cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave") 
			        
				          if Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Leer("Principal") 
				          
				               nPrecio = Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Leer("Precio")
				               nPrecioListaViejo = Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Leer("PrecioLista")
		
				   	           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"        	,	cId_Articulo )
					           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			        ,	cNombre ) 
					           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioActual"        	,	nPrecio )
					           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	ThisForm.Tg_textbox1.value )
					           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Moneda"                 ,   Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo") )	  
					           nPrecioNuevo = Round(Nprecio+(Nprecio*ThisForm.Tg_textbox1.value  /100),5)
					           nPrecioListaNuevo = Round(nPrecioListaViejo+(nPrecioListaViejo*ThisForm.Tg_textbox1.value  /100),5)
							   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
							   ***** 09-01-2014
							   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaViejo"        	,	nPrecioListaViejo )
							   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"        	,	nPrecioListaNuevo )
							   ***** 09-01-2014
							   
							   *** 09-01-2014
						                   Nporc_iva = 0
						                   if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
							                   Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
							               Endif    
						                   NprecioVenta = nPrecioNuevo + (thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo") * Nporc_iva / 100)
						                   NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad") / 100)
		    	        		*** 09-01-2014
		
							   
							   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
							   
							   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
							   ************thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
							Endif   
			        endif
		      endif
		      
		   endif
		   
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local cMscaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".PrecioActual"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Variacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".PrecioNuevo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.width = 0
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".preciolistaviejo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".preciolistanuevo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".precioventa"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		thisform.release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion, dFecha, cId_Lista, lCmp_ArtProve, nPrecio, nBoni, nPrecioLista
		
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		***********lCmp_ArtProve = Thisform.Tg_Checkbox1.Value &&& 07/01/2014
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
		   if Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") <> Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		   
		      * Busco el articulo en articulos
		      
		         if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")       
		         
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Costo"           	,	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo") )         
		            thisform.oTblArticulos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         
		         endif
		      
		   endif
		   
		   if alltrim(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value)<>""
		     **** if lCmp_ArtProve &&& 07/01/2014
		         if Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value + Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")
		           if Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Leer("Principal")
		            nPrecio      = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		            nBoni        = Thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Leer("Bonificacion")
		            nPrecioLista = nPrecio / ( 1 - (nBoni/100)) 
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Precio"  	 , nPrecio)                     
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Bonificacion" , nBoni)                     
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PrecioLista"	 , nPrecioLista)                                             
		            thisform.oCmp_ArtProve.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)            
		           Endif 
		         endif
		    ***  endif &&& 07/01/2014
		   endif
		
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		 
		enddo
		
		=fMensAceptar("Se actualizaron los costos y los precios de lista del Proveedor Seleccionado.")
		
		Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value = 0
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.Valid
		Local vGrabacion, nPrecioNuevo, nPrecioListaNuevo, Nporc_iva, NprecioVenta
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If This.Value <> 0 
			nPrecioNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * This.Value /100),5)
			nPrecioListaNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") * This.Value /100),5)
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"     ,	nPrecioListaNuevo )
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	This.Value )
		
		    Nporc_iva = 0
		    Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		    if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
				Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
			Endif    
			
			NprecioVenta =  nPrecioNuevo + (thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo") * Nporc_iva / 100)
		    NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad") / 100)
							   
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
		    thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		Else
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") )
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"     ,	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") )
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	0 )
		
		    Nporc_iva = 0
		    Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		    if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
				Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
			Endif    
			
			NprecioVenta =  Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") + (thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo") * Nporc_iva / 100)
		    NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad") / 100)
							   
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
			thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		Endif
		
		Return(.t.)
		
		      
		
		         
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		Local nVariacion, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if This.value = 0
		
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"variacion"        	,	0 )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		if (this.value / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")) - 1 < 10
		   nVariacion = Round(((this.value / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")) - 1) * 100, 2)
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"        	,	nVariacion )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		Return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.Text1.Valid
		Local vGrabacion, nPrecioNuevo, nPrecioListaNuevo, Nporc_iva, NprecioVenta
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") = 0
		
				nPrecioNuevo      = Round(This.Value,5)
				nPrecioListaNuevo = Round(This.Value,5)
		
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"     ,	nPrecioListaNuevo )
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	0 )
		
			    Nporc_iva = 0
			    Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
			    if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
					Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
				Endif    
				
				NprecioVenta =  nPrecioNuevo + (Iif(This.Value=0, 1, This.Value) * Nporc_iva / 100)
			    NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad") / 100)
								   
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
			    thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		Else
			If This.Value <> 0 
		
				nPorcentaje = Round((This.Value - Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo")) / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") * 100,2)
		
				nPrecioNuevo      = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * nPorcentaje /100),5)
				nPrecioListaNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") * nPorcentaje /100),5)
		
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"     ,	nPrecioListaNuevo )
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	nPorcentaje )
		
			    Nporc_iva = 0
			    Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
			    if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
					Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
				Endif    
				
				NprecioVenta =  nPrecioNuevo + (Iif(thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo")=0, 1, thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo")) * Nporc_iva / 100)
			    NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad") / 100)
								   
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
			    thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
			Else
		
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") )
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"     ,	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") )
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	0 )
		
			    Nporc_iva = 0
			    Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
			    if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
					Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
				Endif    
				
				NprecioVenta =  Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") + (Iif(thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo")=0, 1, thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo")) * Nporc_iva / 100)
			    NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * Iif(thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad")=0, 1, thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad")) / 100)
								   
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
				thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Endif
		Endif
		
		Return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		
		Thisform.oProveedores.Buscar(This.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.Tg_Label3.Caption = Thisform.oProveedores.Leer("Razon_Social")
		
		dodefault()
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.InteractiveChange
		Local nRegistro, nPrecioNuevo ,nPrecioListaViejo , nPrecioListaNuevo , Nporc_iva , NprecioVenta
		
		nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.recno()
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
			nPrecioNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value /100),5)
		    nPrecioListaNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioListaViejo") * Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value /100),5)
		      
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioListaNuevo"        	,	nPrecioListaNuevo )
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value )
		         
		    *** 09-01-2014
		    Nporc_iva = 0
		    Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		    if Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_AlicuotaIva"),.f.,"Clave")
				Nporc_iva = Thisform.oVnt_AlicuotasIvas.Leer("Porcentaje")
			Endif    
			
			NprecioVenta =  nPrecioNuevo + (thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Costo") * Nporc_iva / 100)
		    NprecioVenta =  NprecioVenta + ( NprecioVenta * thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("Porc_rentabilidad") / 100)
			*** 09-01-2014
							   
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioVenta"        	,	NprecioVenta )
		    thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   	Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE calcularpreciorecargobonif
		lParameters nPrecio,cLista,ClistaBase,Carticulo
		&& LUCAS 14/10/2015
		Local nPreciobase
		
		nPreciobase = 0
		
		if thisform.oVnt_Precios.Buscar(cArticulo+cListabase,.f.,"Clave")    
		                         
			nPreciobase  = thisform.oVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")
			
			if thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Buscar(cLista+ClistaBase)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion1")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion2")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase - round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("bonificacion3")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo1")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo2")/100,2)
			   nPreciobase = nPreciobase + round(nPreciobase*thisform.oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos.Leer("Recargo3")/100,2)
			Endif
		Else
			nPreciobase = nPrecio
		Endif
		
		Retu nPreciobase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularstockgral
		lParameters cId_ArticuloFijo,vVnt_DocuSel,vCmp_DocuSel,vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp,vVnt_AuxSel,vCmp_AuxSel
		 
		
		 
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_articuloFijo )
		thisform.Tg_Articulos1.value= cId_ArticuloFijo
		ThisForm.Tg_LblNomArticulo.Caption=Alltrim(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))  
		
		
		***** david ***
		
		thisform.FijarFiltro(@vVnt_AuxSel,@vCmp_AuxSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp)   
		
		*if type("vVnt_DocuSel")= "L"
		   Dimension vDepositosSel[1,2]
		
		   if thisform.Deposito = "TD"
		      vDepositosSel[1,1]= 2
		   else
		      vDepositosSel[1,1]= 1
		      vDepositosSel[1,2]= thisform.Deposito
		   endif   
		
		   =aCopy(thisform.Cmp_DocuSel,vCmp_DocuAux )
		   =aCopy(thisform.Vnt_DocuSel,vVnt_DocuAux )
		
		   mmpp=  1
		   nCant= 1
		   Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		  
		   For mmpp= 1 to Alen(vCmp_DocuAux,1)
		       if vCmp_DocuAux[mmpp,2]
		          vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]= vCmp_DocuAux[mmpp,1]
		          nCant= nCant+1
		          Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		       endif   
		   EndFor	
		
		   if Alen(vCmp_DocuAux,1) = (nCant -1) .or. nCant= 1
		      vCmp_DocuSel[1,1]= 3
		   else
		      vCmp_DocuSel[1,1]= 1   
		   endif 
		
		   if nCant <> 1
		      Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[alen(vCmp_DocuSel,1)-1,2]
		   endif   
		
		   mmpp=  1
		   nCant= 1
		   Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		  
		   For mmpp= 1 to Alen(vVnt_DocuAux,1)
		       if vVnt_DocuAux[mmpp,2]
		          vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]= vVnt_DocuAux[mmpp,1]
		          nCant= nCant+1
		          Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[nCant,2]
		       endif   
		   EndFor	
		
		   if Alen(vVnt_DocuAux,1)= (nCant -1) .or. nCant= 1
		      vVnt_DocuSel[1,1]= 3
		   else
		      vVnt_DocuSel[1,1]= 1   
		   endif 
		
		   if nCant <> 1
		      Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[alen(vVnt_DocuSel,1)-1,2]
		   endif   
		*endif
		***** david ****
		
		thisform.Tg_TxtStock.value			= Thisform.oCstSistemaStock.ConsultarStockaFecha(cId_ArticuloFijo,@vDepositosSel,oApp.TomarMaximaFecha() )
		ThisForm.Tg_TxtAcPendiente.Value 	= thisform.Tg_TxtStock.value - thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("pendientes")
		thisform.Tg_TxtPendEntrega.value	= Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarCantArticulosPendientes(cId_ArticuloFijo,@vVnt_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta )
		thisform.Tg_TxtDisponible.value 	= thisform.Tg_TxtStock.value - thisform.Tg_TxtPendEntrega.value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
		thisform.Tg_TxtPendRecepcion.value	= Thisform.oCstSistemaCompras.ConsultarCantArticulosPendientes(cId_ArticuloFijo,@vCmp_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaCmp)
		thisform.Tg_TxtDisponibleReal.value	= (thisform.Tg_TxtStock.value - thisform.Tg_TxtPendEntrega.value ) + thisform.Tg_TxtPendRecepcion.value                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
		
		if !Empty(cId_ArticuloFijo)
			thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloFijo)
			thisform.DirImagen 			= alltrim(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("DirImagen"))
			
			** Matias S. 17/05/18 **
			IF Empty(thisform.DirImagen)
				thisform.oTblImagenesArticulos.buscar(cId_ArticuloFijo)
				thisform.DirImagen = alltrim(thisform.oTblImagenesArticulos.Leer("ruta"))
			ENDIF
			** Matias S. 17/05/18 **
			
			if !Empty(thisform.DirImagen)
				thisform.tg_image1.picture  = thisform.DirImagen
			else
				thisform.tg_image1.picture  = ""
			Endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE fijarfiltro
		lParameter vVnt_AuxSel,vCmp_AuxSel,vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp
		
		if Type("vVnt_AuxSel") <> "L"
		   thisform.FechaMaximaCmp= dFechaMaximaCmp
		   thisform.FechaMaximaVta= dFechaMaximaVta
		
		   Dimension thisform.Vnt_DocuSel[alen( vVnt_AuxSel,1),2]
		   Dimension thisform.Cmp_DocuSel[alen( vCmp_AuxSel,1),2]
		   Dimension thisform.DepositosSel[alen(vDepositosSel,1),2]
		
		   =aCopy(vVnt_AuxSel,thisform.Vnt_DocuSel )
		   =aCopy(vCmp_AuxSel,thisform.Cmp_DocuSel )
		   =aCopy(vDepositosSel,thisform.DepositosSel )
		**** prueba ***
		   if thisform.DepositosSel[1,1]= 2
		      thisform.Deposito = "TD"
		   else
		      thisform.Deposito = thisform.DepositosSel[1,2]
		   endif    
		**** prueba ***   
		else
		   thisform.FechaMaximaCmp= thisform.oFormFiltros.MostrarFecPenCmp()
		   thisform.FechaMaximaVta= thisform.oFormFiltros.MostrarFecPendVta() 
		   thisform.Deposito=       thisform.oFormFiltros.MostrarDepositos()
		
		   Dimension thisform.Vnt_DocuSel[alen( thisform.oFormFiltros.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,1),2]
		   Dimension thisform.Cmp_DocuSel[alen( thisform.oFormFiltros.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,1),2]
		  
		   =aCopy(thisform.oFormFiltros.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems, thisform.Vnt_DocuSel )
		   =aCopy(thisform.oFormFiltros.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems, thisform.Cmp_DocuSel )
		  
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Parameters cId_ArticuloFijo,vVnt_DocuSel,vCmp_DocuSel,vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp,vVnt_AuxSel,vCmp_AuxSel
		
		Dodefault()
		
		thisform.tg_Articulos1.Valida=3
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock","Tg_SistemaStock")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaVentas","Tg_SistemaVentas")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaCompras","Tg_SistemaCompras")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImagenesArticulos","Tg_Tabla","imagenes_articulos","Clave")
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormFiltros","Tg_FiltrosPanelArticulos")
		
		&& LUCAS 03/06/2020
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewHistorialArticulos","tg_viewhistorialpreciosarticulo")
		
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		* bombay
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Precios","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Precios","Clave")
		thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.IrPrimero
		thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.IrPrimero
		***************
		thisform.AddObject("oListaPrecios","Tg_Tabla","ListaPrecios","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oMonedas","Tg_Tabla","Monedas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal","Tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		
		&& LUCAS 14/10/2015
		thisform.AddObject("oTblListaPrecios_bonifrecargos"		,"Tg_tabla","ListaPrecios_bonifrecargos","Clave")	
		&& LUCAS 14/10/2015
		
		
		If !Empty(Thisform.oParametros.Leer("Moneda_Panel_Control"))
			Thisform.MonedaGral		= Thisform.oParametros.Leer("Moneda_Panel_Control")
		Else
			Thisform.MonedaGral		= Thisform.oParametros.Leer("Mon_Def")
		Endif	
		
		Thisform.MonedaSistema 	= Thisform.oParametros.Leer("Mon_Def")
		
		
		Thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.MonedaGral)
		Thisform.NombreMonedaGral = Thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
		
		
		Thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.MonedaSistema)
		Thisform.NombreMonedaSist = Thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
		
		if !Empty(cId_ArticuloFijo)
			thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloFijo)
			thisform.DirImagen 			= alltrim(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("DirImagen"))
			
			** Matias S. 17/05/18 **
			IF Empty(thisform.DirImagen)
				thisform.oTblImagenesArticulos.buscar(cId_ArticuloFijo)
				thisform.DirImagen = alltrim(thisform.oTblImagenesArticulos.Leer("ruta"))
			ENDIF
			** Matias S. 17/05/18 **
			
			if !Empty(thisform.DirImagen)
				thisform.tg_image1.picture  = thisform.DirImagen
			else
				thisform.tg_image1.picture  = ""
			Endif
		Endif
		
		
		if Type("cId_ArticuloFijo")<> "L"
		   thisform.Ocultar= .T.
		   thisform.CalcularStockGral(cId_ArticuloFijo,@vVnt_DocuSel,@vCmp_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp,@vVnt_AuxSel,@vCmp_AuxSel ) 
		else 
		   thisform.Ocultar= .F.
		   thisform.Tg_Articulos1.enabled= .t.
		endif   
		
		
		thisform.tg_Articulos1.SetFocus
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    if thisform.Ocultar
		       thisform.Hide
		    else
		       thisform.Release
		    endif      
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_articulos1.Valid
		local lValida, vVnt_DocuSel,vCmp_DocuSel,vDepositosSel
		local dFechaMaximaVta,dFechaMaximaCmp, cDeposito, mmpp, nCant
		
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		1
		thisform.FijarFiltro( )
		
		if !empty(this.value)
		
		   if type("thisform.Vnt_DocuSel")<> "L"
		      Dimension vVnt_DocuSel[alen(thisform.Vnt_DocuSel,1),2]
		      Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[alen(thisform.Cmp_DocuSel,1),2]
		      Dimension vDepositosSel[alen(thisform.DepositosSel,1),2]
		
		      =Acopy(thisform.Vnt_DocuSel, vVnt_DocuSel )
		      =Acopy(thisform.Cmp_DocuSel, vCmp_DocuSel )
		      =Acopy(thisform.DepositosSel,vDepositosSel)
		
		   endif
		   
		   thisform.CalcularStockGral(this.value,@vVnt_DocuSel,@vCmp_DocuSel,@vDepositosSel,thisform.FechaMaximaVta,thisform.FechaMaximaCmp)
		   
		   * edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		   * bombay
		   Thisform.oVnt_precios.Buscar(This.value+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		   Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		   
		   ** Busco el Precio 1
		   Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = thisform.CalcularPrecioRecargoBonif(thisform.oVnt_precios.Leer("precio"), thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value, thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_ListaBase"), this.value)
		
		   ** Busco el Precio 2
		   Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = thisform.CalcularPrecioRecargoBonif(thisform.oVnt_precios.Leer("precio"), thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value, thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_ListaBase"), this.value)
		   
		   ** Busco la moneda de la lista y el nombre de la misma
		   Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value)
		   nMonedaLista1 = Thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Moneda")
		   Thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(nMonedaLista1)
		   thisform.NombreMonedaLista1 = Thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
		   
		   ** Cargo el nombre de la moneda de lista 1 para el primer precio 
		   thisform.tg_Label7.caption = Alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista1)
		
		   if nMonedaLista1 <> Thisform.MonedaGral 
				Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value,nMonedaLista1,0,Thisform.MonedaGral,0)
				Thisform.Tg_Label8.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.NombreMonedaGral)		
		   else
		   		if nMonedaLista1 <> Thisform.MonedaSistema
					Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value,nMonedaLista1,0,Thisform.MonedaSistema,0)		   
					Thisform.Tg_Label8.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.NombreMonedaSist)					
				else
					Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value,nMonedaLista1,0,nMonedaLista1,0)		   				
					Thisform.Tg_Label8.Caption = alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista1)					
				Endif
			Endif
		   
			if !Empty(this.value)
				thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(This.Value)
				thisform.DirImagen 			= thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("DirImagen")
			
				** Matias S. 17/05/18 **
				IF Empty(thisform.DirImagen)
					thisform.oTblImagenesArticulos.buscar(This.Value)
					thisform.DirImagen = alltrim(thisform.oTblImagenesArticulos.Leer("ruta"))
				ENDIF
				** Matias S. 17/05/18 **
					
				thisform.tg_image1.picture  = thisform.DirImagen
			Endif   
		
		
			Thisform.oVnt_precios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Articulos1.value+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
			
			** Busco el Precio 1
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = thisform.CalcularPrecioRecargoBonif(thisform.oVnt_precios.Leer("precio"), thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value, thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_ListaBase"), this.value)
		
			** Busco el Precio 2
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.CalcularPrecioRecargoBonif(thisform.oVnt_precios.Leer("precio"), thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value, thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_ListaBase"), this.value)
			   
			** Busco la moneda de la lista y el nombre de la misma
			Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value)
			nMonedaLista2 = Thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Moneda")
			Thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(nMonedaLista2)
			thisform.NombreMonedaLista2 = Thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
			   
			** Cargo el nombre de la moneda de lista 1 para el primer precio 
			thisform.tg_Label9.caption = Alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista2)
		
			if nMonedaLista2 <> Thisform.MonedaGral 
				Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value,nMonedaLista2,0,Thisform.MonedaGral,0)
				Thisform.Tg_Label10.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.NombreMonedaGral)		
			else
				if nMonedaLista2 <> Thisform.MonedaSistema
					Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value,nMonedaLista2,0,Thisform.MonedaSistema,0)		   
					Thisform.Tg_Label10.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.NombreMonedaSist)					
				else
					Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value,nMonedaLista2,0,nMonedaLista2,0)		   				
					Thisform.Tg_Label10.Caption = alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista2)					
				Endif
			Endif
		
			IF Thisform.oParametros.Leer("panel_de_articulos_mostrar_fechaact")
				Thisform.olblUltFechaAct.Visible = .T.
				Thisform.olblUltFechaAct.Caption = "Fecha últ. act. de precios: " + ALLTRIM(Thisform.oViewHistorialArticulos.Refrescar(This.Value))
			ELSE
				Thisform.olblUltFechaAct.Visible = .F.
			Endif
		endif   
		Return lValida
	ENDPROC

				Thisform.Tg_Label8.Caption = alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista1)					
			Endif
		Endif
		
		
		
		   
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmblistaprecios2.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.oVnt_precios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_Articulos1.value+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		
		** Busco el Precio 3
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = thisform.CalcularPrecioRecargoBonif(thisform.oVnt_precios.Leer("precio"), thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value, thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_ListaBase"), ThisForm.Tg_articulos1.Value)
		
		** Busco el Precio 4
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.CalcularPrecioRecargoBonif(thisform.oVnt_precios.Leer("precio"), thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value, thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_ListaBase"), ThisForm.Tg_articulos1.Value)
		   
		** Busco la moneda de la lista y el nombre de la misma
		Thisform.oListaPrecios.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value)
		nMonedaLista2 = Thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Moneda")
		Thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(nMonedaLista2)
		thisform.NombreMonedaLista2 = Thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
		   
		** Cargo el nombre de la moneda de lista 1 para el primer precio 
		thisform.tg_Label9.caption = Alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista2)
		
		if nMonedaLista2 <> Thisform.MonedaGral 
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value,nMonedaLista2,0,Thisform.MonedaGral,0)
			Thisform.Tg_Label10.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.NombreMonedaGral)		
		else
			if nMonedaLista2 <> Thisform.MonedaSistema
				Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value,nMonedaLista2,0,Thisform.MonedaSistema,0)		   
				Thisform.Tg_Label10.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.NombreMonedaSist)					
			else
				Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value,nMonedaLista2,0,nMonedaLista2,0)		   				
				Thisform.Tg_Label10.Caption = alltrim(thisform.NombreMonedaLista2)					
			Endif
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

		Dimension vCmp_DocuSel[alen(thisform.Cmp_DocuSel,1),2]

		endif
		
		****** prueba ******
	ENDPROC
