	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Plan, cId_Articulo, nCantiPlan
		
		Local vGrabacion, cFiltro, nCantidad, n
		
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarDetalladoCompras")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oProveedores","Tg_Tabla","Proveedores","Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oPrd_CmptPendientes","Tg_Tabla","Prd_CmptPendientes","Clave") &&index id_plan
		
		thisform.AddObject("oParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"clave")
		
		Thisform.Tg_Label2.Caption = "Artículo:  ("+cId_Articulo+")  "+Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		Thisform.Tg_Label1.Caption = "Cantidad Pendiente al calculo del Plan: "+str(nCantiplan,12,2)
		
		Dimension vComprobantes[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oPrd_CmptPendientes.Buscar(cId_Plan,.f.,"Clave")
		n = 1
		Do While !Thisform.oPrd_CmptPendientes.EsEof() and Thisform.oPrd_CmptPendientes.Leer("id_Plan")=cId_Plan
		   Dimension vComprobantes[n,2]
		   vComprobantes[n,1]=Thisform.oPrd_CmptPendientes.Leer("id_Comproba")
		   vComprobantes[n,2]=.t.
		   n=n+1
		   Thisform.oPrd_CmptPendientes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"","TD ",ctod("  /  /  "),ctod("  /  /  "),cId_Articulo,cId_Articulo,"TD ","TD ","TD ",ThisForm.oParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"),1,ctod("  /  /  "),ctod("  /  /  "))
		
		nCantidad = 0
		
		thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.IrPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.EsEof()
		   Thisform.oProveedores.Buscar(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Proveedor"),.f.,"Clave") 
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Detalle"        ,Thisform.oProveedores.Leer("Razon_Social"))
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cant_Cancelada" ,thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Pendiente") / thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Cant_Pendiente"))
		   thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   nCantidad = nCantidad + thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.Tg_Label3.Caption = "Total Pendiente Actual:  "+Str(nCantidad,12,2)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Detalle"	
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cantidad"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Cancelada"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Pendiente"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Id_Proveedor"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nombre"
		*!*	Thisform.tg_grid1.Column15.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column16.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".VencArticulo"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".VencArticulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Detalle"	
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Cancelada"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Pendiente"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.Tg_Grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		   thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
		   Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
	ENDPROC
